FILE: app/src/main/java/com/myapp/adventure/data/theme/ThemeRepository.kt
================================================
package com.myapp.adventure.data.theme

import androidx.datastore.core.DataStore
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.Preferences
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.edit
import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.collect
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.combine
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.onEach
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.serialization.builtins.ListSerializer
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

/**
 * Single source of truth for theme state: which theme is active, its
 * night-mode override, and the list of user-created themes.
 *
 * Backed by a [DataStore] (see [ThemeDataStore]). The class caches the
 * latest state in memory as volatile fields so synchronous UI code
 * (`ThemeManager.currentThemeSync()` for Compose) can read it without
 * blocking. All writes go through DataStore; the cache is updated
 * optimistically so reads immediately reflect the change.
 *
 * Threading: the constructor starts a coroutine in [scope] that keeps the
 * cache in sync with DataStore. Call [awaitInitialized] before relying on
 * the cache; it suspends only until the first DataStore emission has been
 * processed, not until the DataStore closes.
 */
class ThemeRepository(
    private val dataStore: DataStore<Preferences>,
    private val scope: CoroutineScope,
) {

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // In-memory cache (volatile: written from IO, read from main)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    @Volatile private var cachedThemeId: String = ThemeSelection.DEFAULT_THEME_ID
    @Volatile private var cachedNightMode: Int = ThemeSelection.DEFAULT_NIGHT_MODE
    @Volatile private var cachedCustomThemes: List<AppThemeConfig> = emptyList()

    private val initialized = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Flows
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    private val _selection = MutableStateFlow(ThemeSelection.Default)
    val selection: StateFlow<ThemeSelection> = _selection.asStateFlow()

    private val _customThemes = MutableStateFlow<List<AppThemeConfig>>(emptyList())
    val customThemes: StateFlow<List<AppThemeConfig>> = _customThemes.asStateFlow()

    /** All available themes: built-in presets plus user-created ones. */
    val allThemes: StateFlow<List<AppThemeConfig>> =
        combine(selection, customThemes) { _, customs ->
            BuiltInThemes.all + customs
        }.stateIn(scope, SharingStarted.Eagerly, BuiltInThemes.all)

    /** The currently active theme, resolved from [selection]. */
    val currentTheme: StateFlow<AppThemeConfig> =
        combine(selection, customThemes) { sel, customs ->
            BuiltInThemes.byId(sel.themeId)
                ?: customs.firstOrNull { it.id == sel.themeId }
                ?: BuiltInThemes.DEFAULT
        }.stateIn(scope, SharingStarted.Eagerly, BuiltInThemes.DEFAULT)

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Init
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    init {
        scope.launch {
            // onEach fires on every emission, including the first one, so
            // `initialized` completes as soon as the cache is warm.
            // `collect()` then keeps us subscribed for subsequent updates
            // (writes from setX() methods, DataStore edits from elsewhere).
            dataStore.data
                .onEach { prefs ->
                    applyPrefs(prefs)
                    initialized.complete(Unit)   // idempotent
                }
                .collect()
        }
    }

    private fun applyPrefs(prefs: Preferences) {
        val themeId = prefs[ThemePreferences.KEY_THEME_ID]
            ?: ThemeSelection.DEFAULT_THEME_ID
        val nightMode = prefs[ThemePreferences.KEY_NIGHT_MODE]
            ?: ThemeSelection.DEFAULT_NIGHT_MODE
        val customs = decodeCustomThemes(prefs[ThemePreferences.KEY_CUSTOM_THEMES])

        cachedThemeId = themeId
        cachedNightMode = nightMode
        cachedCustomThemes = customs

        _selection.value = ThemeSelection(themeId, nightMode)
        _customThemes.value = customs
    }

    /** Suspends until the initial DataStore read has populated the cache. */
    suspend fun awaitInitialized() = initialized.await()

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Synchronous reads (safe after awaitInitialized)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    fun getThemeIdSync(): String = cachedThemeId
    fun getNightModeSync(): Int = cachedNightMode
    fun getCustomThemesSync(): List<AppThemeConfig> = cachedCustomThemes

    fun getThemeByIdSync(id: String): AppThemeConfig =
        BuiltInThemes.byId(id)
            ?: cachedCustomThemes.firstOrNull { it.id == id }
            ?: BuiltInThemes.DEFAULT

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Writes
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    suspend fun setThemeId(themeId: String) {
        awaitInitialized()
        val safeId = if (isKnownTheme(themeId)) themeId
        else ThemeSelection.DEFAULT_THEME_ID
        cachedThemeId = safeId                         // optimistic update
        dataStore.edit { it[ThemePreferences.KEY_THEME_ID] = safeId }
    }

    suspend fun setNightMode(nightMode: Int) {
        awaitInitialized()
        cachedNightMode = nightMode                    // optimistic update
        dataStore.edit { it[ThemePreferences.KEY_NIGHT_MODE] = nightMode }
    }

    suspend fun setTheme(themeId: String, nightMode: Int) {
        awaitInitialized()
        val safeId = if (isKnownTheme(themeId)) themeId
        else ThemeSelection.DEFAULT_THEME_ID
        cachedThemeId = safeId
        cachedNightMode = nightMode
        dataStore.edit {
            it[ThemePreferences.KEY_THEME_ID] = safeId
            it[ThemePreferences.KEY_NIGHT_MODE] = nightMode
        }
    }

    suspend fun addOrReplaceCustomTheme(config: AppThemeConfig) {
        awaitInitialized()
        require(!config.isBuiltIn) {
            "Cannot store a built-in theme as custom: ${config.id}"
        }
        val updated = cachedCustomThemes
            .filterNot { it.id == config.id } + config
        persistCustomThemes(updated)
    }

    suspend fun removeCustomTheme(id: String) {
        awaitInitialized()
        val updated = cachedCustomThemes.filterNot { it.id == id }
        val removeActive = cachedThemeId == id

        cachedCustomThemes = updated
        if (removeActive) cachedThemeId = ThemeSelection.DEFAULT_THEME_ID

        val encoded = json.encodeToString(
            ListSerializer(AppThemeConfig.serializer()),
            updated,
        )
        dataStore.edit { prefs ->
            prefs[ThemePreferences.KEY_CUSTOM_THEMES] = encoded
            if (removeActive) {
                prefs[ThemePreferences.KEY_THEME_ID] = ThemeSelection.DEFAULT_THEME_ID
            }
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Internals
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    private fun isKnownTheme(id: String): Boolean =
        BuiltInThemes.byId(id) != null || cachedCustomThemes.any { it.id == id }

    private suspend fun persistCustomThemes(themes: List<AppThemeConfig>) {
        val encoded = json.encodeToString(
            ListSerializer(AppThemeConfig.serializer()),
            themes,
        )
        cachedCustomThemes = themes                    // optimistic update
        dataStore.edit { it[ThemePreferences.KEY_CUSTOM_THEMES] = encoded }
    }

    private fun decodeCustomThemes(encoded: String?): List<AppThemeConfig> {
        if (encoded.isNullOrBlank()) return emptyList()
        return try {
            json.decodeFromString(
                ListSerializer(AppThemeConfig.serializer()),
                encoded,
            )
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            // Corrupted JSON — drop custom themes silently rather than crash.
            // Logging via Logger requires a folder URI that may not be ready
            // at this point in the startup sequence.
            emptyList()
        }
    }

    companion object {
        private val json = Json {
            ignoreUnknownKeys = true   // forward-compat: old readers don't break on new fields
            encodeDefaults = true
        }
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.data.theme

/**

        val Default = ThemeSelection()
    }

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/myapp/adventure/service/BootReceiver.kt

package com.myapp.adventure.service

import android.Manifest
import android.content.BroadcastReceiver
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.os.Build
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import com.myapp.adventure.step.StepSourceManager
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.Logger

/**
 * Restarts the step pipeline after a device reboot or an app update.
 *
 *  - BOOT_COMPLETED: the system killed our process at shutdown; nothing else
 *    will restart the foreground service, so we do it ourselves.
 *  - MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED: user updated the app; the process was killed during
 *    install and would otherwise stay dead until the user opens the app.
 */
class BootReceiver : BroadcastReceiver() {
    override fun onReceive(context: Context, intent: Intent) {
        val action = intent.action
        if (action != Intent.ACTION_BOOT_COMPLETED &&
            action != Intent.ACTION_MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED
        ) return

        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences("adventure_prefs", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        val folderUri = prefs.getString("adventure_folder_uri", null) ?: return

        Logger.init(context, folderUri)
        Logger.log(context, "BootReceiver: received $action")

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q &&
            ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, Manifest.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION)
            != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        ) {
            Logger.log(context, "BootReceiver: ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION denied; not starting service")
        } else {
            try {
                val svc = Intent(context, StepCounterService::class.java)
                    .setAction(StepCounterConstants.ACTION_START)
                ContextCompat.startForegroundService(context, svc)
                Logger.log(context, "BootReceiver: StepCounterService started")
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Logger.log(context, "BootReceiver: failed to start service: ${e.message}")
            }
        }

        StepSourceManager.start(context)
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.service

object StepCounterConstants {
    const val ACTION_START = "com.myapp.adventure.START_STEP_COUNTER"
    const val ACTION_STOP = "com.myapp.adventure.STOP_STEP_COUNTER"
    const val ACTION_UPDATE = "com.myapp.adventure.UPDATE_STEPS"

    /** Absolute (raw) reading from the step counter sensor since boot. */
    const val EXTRA_ABSOLUTE_STEPS = "absolute_steps"

    /** Delta since the previous sensor event (diff of absolute readings). */
    const val EXTRA_DELTA = "delta_steps"

    /**
     * Boolean: whether a step counter sensor is present on this device.
     * Broadcast together with [ACTION_UPDATE] so consumers can react to it.
     */
    const val EXTRA_SENSOR_AVAILABLE = "sensor_available"

    const val NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_ID = "step_counter_channel"
    const val NOTIFICATION_ID = 1
}

package com.myapp.adventure.service

import android.app.Notification
import android.app.NotificationChannel
import android.app.NotificationManager
import android.app.PendingIntent
import android.app.Service
import com.myapp.adventure.R
import android.Manifest
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.hardware.Sensor
import android.hardware.SensorEvent
import android.hardware.SensorEventListener
import android.hardware.SensorManager
import android.os.Build
import android.os.IBinder
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import com.myapp.adventure.MainActivity
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.Logger
import com.myapp.adventure.step.StepSourceManager
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.StepHistoryManager
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.isActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger

class StepCounterService : Service(), SensorEventListener {

    companion object {
        /** Hint for UI only. Never gate startForeground() on this. */
        var isRunning = false

        /** Last raw absolute reading from the sensor. */
        @Volatile
        var absoluteSteps: Int = 0
            private set

        /** True once at least one sensor event has been received in this process. */
        @Volatile
        var hasFirstEvent: Boolean = false
            private set

        /** True if this device has a TYPE_STEP_COUNTER sensor. */
        @Volatile
        var isSensorAvailable: Boolean = false
            private set

        private const val PREFS_NAME = "step_counter_service_prefs"
        private const val KEY_LAST_RAW = "last_raw_value"
    }

    private lateinit var sensorManager: SensorManager
    private var stepSensor: Sensor? = null
    private var isListening = false

    // ----- Baseline / delta tracking (accessed from onSensorChanged) -----

    /**
     * Last raw value we've seen. Loaded from prefs on start so a process restart
     * (without reboot) doesn't lose the baseline.
     * -1 means "unknown".
     */
    @Volatile
    private var lastRawSteps: Int = -1

    /** True once we have a valid baseline. */
    @Volatile
    private var hasBaseline: Boolean = false

    /** Accumulated delta waiting to be flushed by the background worker. */
    private val pendingDelta = AtomicInteger(0)

    /** Set by onSensorChanged when a sensor reboot is detected; consumed in the worker. */
    private val rebootDetected = AtomicBoolean(false)

    // ----- Background worker -----

    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)
    private var workerJob: Job? = null

    // ==================== Lifecycle ====================

    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()

        val prefs = getSharedPreferences("adventure_prefs", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        val folderUriString = prefs.getString("adventure_folder_uri", null)
        if (folderUriString != null) {
            Logger.init(applicationContext, folderUriString)
        }

        createNotificationChannel()

        sensorManager = getSystemService(Context.SENSOR_SERVICE) as SensorManager
        stepSensor = sensorManager.getDefaultSensor(Sensor.TYPE_STEP_COUNTER)
        isSensorAvailable = stepSensor != null

        val savedRaw = loadLastRaw()
        if (savedRaw >= 0) {
            lastRawSteps = savedRaw
            hasBaseline = true
        }

        Logger.log(
            applicationContext,
            "StepCounterService created, sensor: ${if (isSensorAvailable) "available" else "MISSING"}, " +
                    "savedRaw=$savedRaw"
        )
    }

    override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
        Logger.log(
            applicationContext,
            "onStartCommand: action=${intent?.action}, isRunning=$isRunning, isListening=$isListening"
        )

        when (intent?.action) {
            StepCounterConstants.ACTION_STOP -> {
                Logger.log(applicationContext, "ACTION_STOP received, stopping service")
                shutdown()
                return START_NOT_STICKY
            }
            else -> {
                // ACTION_START, null (START_STICKY restart), or unknown action.
                // Android 14+ requires a runtime prerequisite for the `health`
                // foreground-service type; without it startForeground() throws
                // SecurityException and kills the process. See:
                // https://developer.android.com/develop/background-work/services/fgs/launch
                if (!hasActivityRecognitionPermission()) {
                    Logger.log(
                        applicationContext,
                        "ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION not granted; not starting foreground service"
                    )
                    stopSelf()
                    return START_NOT_STICKY
                }
                // startForeground is idempotent; Android 12+ requires it within 5s.
                startForeground(StepCounterConstants.NOTIFICATION_ID, buildNotificationStatic())
                isRunning = true

                if (!isListening && stepSensor != null) {
                    sensorManager.registerListener(
                        this,
                        stepSensor,
                        SensorManager.SENSOR_DELAY_NORMAL
                    )
                    isListening = true
                    Logger.log(applicationContext, "Sensor listener registered")
                }

                startWorker()
            }
        }
        return START_STICKY
    }

    override fun onBind(intent: Intent?): IBinder? = null

    override fun onDestroy() {
        stopWorker()
        stopListening()
        isRunning = false
        Logger.log(applicationContext, "StepCounterService destroyed")
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    // ==================== Sensor ====================

    override fun onSensorChanged(event: SensorEvent?) {
        if (event?.sensor?.type != Sensor.TYPE_STEP_COUNTER) return

        val raw = event.values[0].toInt()
        absoluteSteps = raw
        hasFirstEvent = true

        // Sensor reboot detection: a fresh boot resets the counter to a small value.
        if (hasBaseline && raw < lastRawSteps) {
            lastRawSteps = raw
            saveLastRaw(raw)
            pendingDelta.set(0)
            rebootDetected.set(true)
            broadcastUpdate(raw, 0)
            return
        }

        val delta = if (hasBaseline) (raw - lastRawSteps).coerceAtLeast(0) else 0
        if (!hasBaseline) {
            hasBaseline = true
        }
        lastRawSteps = raw
        saveLastRaw(raw)

        if (delta > 0) {
            pendingDelta.addAndGet(delta)
        }

        broadcastUpdate(raw, delta)
    }

    override fun onAccuracyChanged(sensor: Sensor?, accuracy: Int) {}

    private fun broadcastUpdate(raw: Int, delta: Int) {
        sendBroadcast(
            Intent(StepCounterConstants.ACTION_UPDATE).apply {
                setPackage(packageName)
                putExtra(StepCounterConstants.EXTRA_ABSOLUTE_STEPS, raw)
                putExtra(StepCounterConstants.EXTRA_DELTA, delta)
                putExtra(StepCounterConstants.EXTRA_SENSOR_AVAILABLE, isSensorAvailable)
            }
        )
    }

    private fun stopListening() {
        if (isListening) {
            sensorManager.unregisterListener(this)
            isListening = false
        }
    }

    /**
     * True if the app may legally start a `health` foreground service on this
     * device. From Android 10 (API 29) the `ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION` runtime
     * permission is the prerequisite; on API 34+ the system enforces it by
     * throwing SecurityException from startForeground().
     */
    private fun hasActivityRecognitionPermission(): Boolean {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) return true
        return ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(
            this, Manifest.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION
        ) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
    }

    // ==================== Background worker ====================

    /**
     * Runs while the service is in foreground.
     * Every 1.5s drains pendingDelta into StepHistoryManager, every ~15s refreshes the notification.
     * Does NOT touch the sensor.
     */
    private fun startWorker() {
        stopWorker()
        workerJob = scope.launch {
            var ticksSinceNotifUpdate = 0
            while (isActive) {
                delay(1_500L)

                val delta = pendingDelta.getAndSet(0)
                if (delta > 0) {
                    // When HC is the active source, its own delta tracking
                    // already covers these steps. Recording the sensor delta
                    // would double-count them.
                    if (!StepSourceManager.isHealthConnectActuallyUsable(applicationContext)) {
                        try {
                            StepHistoryManager.recordDelta(applicationContext, delta)
                        } catch (e: Exception) {
                            Logger.log(applicationContext, "recordDelta failed: ${e.message}")
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (rebootDetected.compareAndSet(true, false)) {
                    Logger.log(
                        applicationContext,
                        "Sensor reboot detected, baseline reset to $lastRawSteps " +
                                "(raw counter restarted after boot; deltas resume from this point)"
                    )
                }

                ticksSinceNotifUpdate++
                if (ticksSinceNotifUpdate >= 10) {
                    ticksSinceNotifUpdate = 0
                    refreshNotificationContent()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun stopWorker() {
        workerJob?.cancel()
        workerJob = null
    }

    private fun shutdown() {
        stopWorker()
        stopListening()
        // Try to flush the last pending delta before stopping.
        val tail = pendingDelta.getAndSet(0)
        if (tail > 0) {
            scope.launch {
                try {
                    StepHistoryManager.recordDelta(applicationContext, tail)
                } catch (_: Exception) {
                }
            }
        }
        isRunning = false
        stopForeground(STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE)
        stopSelf()
    }

    // ==================== Notification ====================

    /** Static notification used to satisfy startForeground() within 5s. */
    private fun buildNotificationStatic(): Notification {
        val text = when {
            !isSensorAvailable -> getString(R.string.step_service_sensor_unavailable)
            !hasFirstEvent -> getString(R.string.step_service_waiting_for_sensor)
            else -> getString(R.string.step_service_tracking_active)
        }
        return newNotificationBuilder()
            .setContentText(text)
            .build()
    }

    private fun refreshNotificationContent() {
        if (!isRunning) return

        val todaySteps = try {
            StepHistoryManager.getTodaySteps(applicationContext)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            0
        }

        val text = when {
            !isSensorAvailable -> getString(R.string.step_service_sensor_unavailable)
            !hasFirstEvent -> getString(R.string.step_service_waiting_for_sensor)
            else -> {
                val stepsText = com.myapp.adventure.utils.ruQuantityString(
                    this, com.myapp.adventure.R.plurals.steps, todaySteps
                )
                getString(R.string.step_service_today_steps_fmt, stepsText)
            }
        }

        val notification = newNotificationBuilder()
            .setContentText(text)
            .build()

        val manager = getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
        manager.notify(StepCounterConstants.NOTIFICATION_ID, notification)
    }

    private fun newNotificationBuilder(): NotificationCompat.Builder {
        val pendingIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(
            this,
            0,
            Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java),
            PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
        )
        return NotificationCompat.Builder(this, StepCounterConstants.NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_ID)
            .setContentTitle(getString(R.string.step_service_notification_title))
            .setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_stat_name)
            .setContentIntent(pendingIntent)
            .setOngoing(true)
            .setOnlyAlertOnce(true)
    }

    private fun createNotificationChannel() {
        val channel = NotificationChannel(
            StepCounterConstants.NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_ID,
            getString(R.string.step_service_channel_name),
            NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW
        )
        val manager = getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
        manager.createNotificationChannel(channel)
    }

    // ==================== Baseline persistence ====================

    private fun saveLastRaw(value: Int) {
        try {
            getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit()
                .putInt(KEY_LAST_RAW, value)
                .apply()
        } catch (_: Exception) {
        }
    }

    private fun loadLastRaw(): Int {
        return try {
            getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .getInt(KEY_LAST_RAW, -1)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            -1
        }
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.step

import android.content.Context
import android.os.Build
import androidx.health.connect.client.HealthConnectClient
import androidx.health.connect.client.permission.HealthPermission
import androidx.health.connect.client.records.StepsRecord
import androidx.health.connect.client.request.AggregateRequest
import androidx.health.connect.client.time.TimeRangeFilter
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.Logger
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.ZoneId

/**
 * Health Connect step source.
 *
 * Reports today's HC step total as a series of deltas. The "last seen total"
 * and the date it belongs to are persisted to SharedPreferences so that:
 *  - the first poll of a new day returns *today's full aggregate* (captures
 *    all steps the user took since midnight, not just steps after app launch);
 *  - subsequent polls of the same day return only new steps;
 *  - process restarts mid-day do not reset the baseline (no step loss).
 */
class HealthConnectStepSource : StepSource {

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "HealthConnectStepSource"
        const val PROVIDER_PACKAGE = "com.google.android.apps.healthdata"

        private const val HC_PREFS = "hc_step_source_prefs"
        private const val KEY_LAST_SEEN_DATE = "last_seen_date"
        private const val KEY_LAST_SEEN_TOTAL = "last_seen_total"
    }

    override val id: String = "health_connect"

    override fun isAvailable(context: Context): Boolean {
        // On Android 14+ (SDK 34) Health Connect is a system service and the
        // legacy provider package `com.google.android.apps.healthdata` is not
        // installed. Passing that package name makes getSdkStatus() return
        // SDK_UNAVAILABLE_PROVIDER_UPDATE_REQUIRED and effectively disables HC.
        val status = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.UPSIDE_DOWN_CAKE) {
            HealthConnectClient.getSdkStatus(context)
        } else {
            HealthConnectClient.getSdkStatus(context, PROVIDER_PACKAGE)
        }
        return status == HealthConnectClient.SDK_AVAILABLE
    }

    suspend fun hasReadPermission(context: Context): Boolean {
        return try {
            val client = HealthConnectClient.getOrCreate(context)
            val granted = client.permissionController.getGrantedPermissions()
            granted.contains(HealthPermission.getReadPermission(StepsRecord::class))
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(context, "$TAG: permission check failed: ${e.message}")
            false
        }
    }

    override suspend fun getDelta(context: Context): Int {
        if (!hasReadPermission(context)) {
            // Logged once at poll level by StepSourceManager as permission_missing;
            // no need to spam per-poll here.
            return 0
        }

        val today = LocalDate.now()
        val todayKey = today.toString()

        return try {
            val client = HealthConnectClient.getOrCreate(context)
            val zone = ZoneId.systemDefault()
            val start = today.atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant()
            val end = Instant.now()

            val response = client.aggregate(
                AggregateRequest(
                    metrics = setOf(StepsRecord.COUNT_TOTAL),
                    timeRangeFilter = TimeRangeFilter.between(start, end)
                )
            )
            val total = response[StepsRecord.COUNT_TOTAL] ?: 0L

            val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(HC_PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            val savedDate = prefs.getString(KEY_LAST_SEEN_DATE, null)
            val savedTotal = prefs.getLong(KEY_LAST_SEEN_TOTAL, 0L)

            val lastSeen = if (savedDate == todayKey) savedTotal else 0L
            val delta = (total - lastSeen).coerceAtLeast(0L)

            prefs.edit()
                .putString(KEY_LAST_SEEN_DATE, todayKey)
                .putLong(KEY_LAST_SEEN_TOTAL, total)
                .apply()

            // Log on first poll of the day (or when delta arrives). Normal
            // "no new steps since last poll" is silent.
            if (delta > 0 || savedDate != todayKey) {
                Logger.log(
                    context,
                    "$TAG: HC todayTotal=$total, lastSeen=$lastSeen, delta=$delta"
                )
            }
            delta.toInt()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(context, "$TAG: aggregate failed: ${e.message}")
            0
        }
    }

    /** Called by StepSourceManager on day rollover to reset baseline. */
    fun onDayChanged(context: Context) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(HC_PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit().clear().apply()
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.step

import android.content.Context
import com.myapp.adventure.service.StepCounterService

/**
 * Wraps [StepCounterService] as a [StepSource].
 *
 * The service already accumulates a delta in [StepCounterService] and writes
 * to [StepHistoryManager]. To avoid double-counting, this source does NOT
 * call recordDelta itself — it only reports what the service has accumulated
 * since the last poll via [consumePendingDelta].
 *
 * Note: StepCounterService writes to StepHistoryManager independently, so this
 * source's delta is informational for the manager (used to compare with HC).
 * The manager applies max-per-bucket semantics when both sources report.
 */
class SensorStepSource : StepSource {

    override val id: String = "sensor"

    override fun isAvailable(context: Context): Boolean {
        return StepCounterService.isSensorAvailable
    }

    override suspend fun getDelta(context: Context): Int {
        // Sensor source does not push deltas through StepSourceManager;
        // StepCounterService already writes them directly.
        // Returning 0 keeps StepSourceManager idempotent.
        return 0
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.step

import android.content.Context

/**
 * Abstraction over a step data source.
 *
 * Implementations must be cheap to construct. Heavy initialization belongs
 * in [StepSourceManager].
 */
interface StepSource {

    /** Stable identifier used for logging and prefs. */
    val id: String

    /**
     * Whether this source can currently be used.
     * For Health Connect this checks [HealthConnectClient.getSdkStatus] and
     * whether the READ_STEPS permission has been granted.
     */
    fun isAvailable(context: Context): Boolean

    /**
     * Delta (steps) since the previous call. Return 0 if nothing new.
     *
     * Implementations must handle their own baseline internally. For the sensor
     * source, delta is derived from [StepCounterService] events. For Health
     * Connect, delta is derived from aggregate calls over a sliding window.
     */
    suspend fun getDelta(context: Context): Int
}

package com.myapp.adventure.step

import android.content.Context
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.Logger
import com.myapp.adventure.utils.StepHistoryManager
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.isActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

/**
 * Chooses the active step source and polls it periodically.
 *
 * Rules:
 *  - HC enabled + installed + permission granted → HC is the active source.
 *    Sensor deltas are suppressed by StepCounterService to avoid double-count.
 *  - Otherwise → sensor is the active source (StepCounterService writes deltas
 *    directly). The poll loop is a no-op in this mode.
 *
 * [isHealthConnectActuallyUsable] is the single point of truth used by both
 * this class and [com.myapp.adventure.service.StepCounterService].
 */
object StepSourceManager {

    private const val TAG = "StepSourceManager"
    private const val PREFS_NAME = "step_source_prefs"
    private const val KEY_USE_HEALTH_CONNECT = "use_health_connect"
    private const val POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 60_000L

    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)
    private var pollJob: Job? = null

    private val sensorSource = SensorStepSource()
    private val healthConnectSource = HealthConnectStepSource()

    /**
     * Last observed "HC actually usable" state (enabled + available + permission).
     * Starts false; updated on each pollOnce. Sensor suppresses its own deltas
     * while this is true.
     */
    @Volatile
    private var hcUsable: Boolean = false

    /** For "state changed" logging only; suppresses per-poll noise. */
    private var lastHcState: String = "unknown"

    // ----- User preference -----

    fun isHealthConnectEnabled(context: Context): Boolean {
        return context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .getBoolean(KEY_USE_HEALTH_CONNECT, false)
    }

    fun setHealthConnectEnabled(context: Context, enabled: Boolean) {
        context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            .edit().putBoolean(KEY_USE_HEALTH_CONNECT, enabled).apply()
        Logger.log(context, "$TAG: Health Connect enabled=$enabled")
        hcUsable = false
        restartPolling(context.applicationContext)
    }

    /**
     * True iff HC is enabled by the user, available on the device, and its
     * read permission was confirmed granted on a recent poll.
     *
     * This is what StepCounterService checks before recording its own deltas.
     */
    fun isHealthConnectActuallyUsable(context: Context): Boolean {
        if (!isHealthConnectEnabled(context)) return false
        if (!healthConnectSource.isAvailable(context)) return false
        return hcUsable
    }

    /** Kept for SettingsScreen; identical to [isHealthConnectActuallyUsable]. */
    fun isHealthConnectActive(context: Context): Boolean =
        isHealthConnectActuallyUsable(context)

    // ----- Lifecycle -----

    fun start(context: Context) {
        restartPolling(context.applicationContext)
    }

    fun stop() {
        pollJob?.cancel()
        pollJob = null
        hcUsable = false
    }

    private fun restartPolling(appContext: Context) {
        stop()
        pollJob = scope.launch {
            while (isActive) {
                try {
                    pollOnce(appContext)
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    Logger.log(appContext, "$TAG: poll failed: ${e.message}")
                }
                delay(POLL_INTERVAL_MS)
            }
        }
    }

    private suspend fun pollOnce(appContext: Context) {
        val enabled = isHealthConnectEnabled(appContext)
        val available = enabled && healthConnectSource.isAvailable(appContext)
        val permitted = available && healthConnectSource.hasReadPermission(appContext)

        val newState = when {
            !enabled -> "disabled"
            !available -> "unavailable"
            !permitted -> "permission_missing"
            else -> "active"
        }
        if (newState != lastHcState) {
            Logger.log(appContext, "$TAG: HC state=$newState")
            lastHcState = newState
        }
        hcUsable = (newState == "active")
        if (!hcUsable) return

        val delta = healthConnectSource.getDelta(appContext)
        if (delta > 0) {
            StepHistoryManager.applyHealthConnectDelta(appContext, delta)
        }
    }
}

 * route patterns short and stable.
 */
object AppRoutes {

    @Serializable @SerialName("menu") data object Menu
    @Serializable @SerialName("library") data object Library

    @Serializable @SerialName("settings") data object Settings
    @Serializable @SerialName("editor") data object Editor
    @Serializable @SerialName("editor_meta") data object EditMeta
    @Serializable @SerialName("editor_templates") data object Templates
    @Serializable @SerialName("editor_subroutines") data object Subroutines
    @Serializable @SerialName("editor_validation") data object Validation
    @Serializable @SerialName("editor_search") data object Search
    @Serializable @SerialName("editor_stats") data object StoryStats
    @Serializable @SerialName("reader") data class Reader(
        val fileUri: String? = null,
        val previewId: String? = null,
    )
}

/**
 * Phase 4-c: single Activity-level Compose navigation graph.
 *
 * Scoping:
 *  - `AdventureEditorViewModel` is **Activity-scoped** (shared with the
 *    editor child routes) and survives leaving the editor, as before.
 *  - `AdventureReaderViewModel` is **NavBackStackEntry-scoped** via
 *    `viewModel()` inside the reader destination, so popping the reader
 *    disposes it and a fresh open re-runs `init`.
 *  - Reader preview payloads live in the Activity-scoped
 *    [ReaderPreviewViewModel] (large JSON is not put into the route).
 */
@Composable
fun AppNavHost(
    navController: NavHostController = rememberNavController(),
) {
    NavHost(
        navController = navController,
        startDestination = AppRoutes.Setup,
    ) {
        composable<AppRoutes.Setup> {
            SetupScreen(
                onNavigateToList = {
                    navController.navigate(AppRoutes.Menu) {
                        popUpTo<AppRoutes.Setup> { inclusive = true }
                    }
                },
            )
        }

        composable<AppRoutes.Menu> {
            MenuScreen(
                onNavigate = { destination ->
                    when (destination) {
                        MenuDestination.Library -> navController.navigate(AppRoutes.Library)
                        MenuDestination.Create -> navController.navigate(AppRoutes.Editor)
                        MenuDestination.Statistics -> navController.navigate(AppRoutes.Statistics)
                        MenuDestination.Logs -> navController.navigate(AppRoutes.Logs)
                        MenuDestination.Settings -> navController.navigate(AppRoutes.Settings)
                    }
                },
            )
        }

        composable<AppRoutes.Library> {
            AdventureListScreen(
                onNavigateToMenu = { navigateBackOrMenu(navController) },
                onOpenAdventure = { uri ->
                    navController.navigate(AppRoutes.Reader(fileUri = uri.toString()))
                },
            )
        }

        composable<AppRoutes.Statistics> {
            StatisticsScreen(onNavigateToMenu = { navigateBackOrMenu(navController) })
        }

        composable<AppRoutes.Logs> {
            LogViewerScreen()
        }

        composable<AppRoutes.Settings> {
            SettingsScreen()
        }

        composable<AppRoutes.Editor> {
            FontScopeProvider(FontScope.EDITOR) {
                val editorViewModel = activityEditorViewModel()
                val previewViewModel = activityReaderPreviewViewModel()
                EditorRoute(
                    viewModel = editorViewModel,
                    onNavigate = { destination ->
                        when (destination) {
                            EditorDestination.Menu -> navController.navigate(AppRoutes.Menu)
                            EditorDestination.Templates -> navController.navigate(AppRoutes.Templates)
                            EditorDestination.Subroutines -> navController.navigate(AppRoutes.Subroutines)
                            EditorDestination.Meta -> navController.navigate(AppRoutes.EditMeta)
                            EditorDestination.Validation -> navController.navigate(AppRoutes.Validation)
                            EditorDestination.Search -> navController.navigate(AppRoutes.Search)
                            EditorDestination.Stats -> navController.navigate(AppRoutes.StoryStats)
                        }
                    },
                    onPreviewRequest = { request ->
                        val id = previewViewModel.put(request)
                        navController.navigate(AppRoutes.Reader(previewId = id))
                    },
                )
            }
        }

        composable<AppRoutes.EditMeta> {
            FontScopeProvider(FontScope.EDITOR) {
                EditMetaRoute(
                    viewModel = activityEditorViewModel(),
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                )
            }
        }

        composable<AppRoutes.Templates> {
            FontScopeProvider(FontScope.EDITOR) {
                TemplateListScreen(
                    viewModel = activityEditorViewModel(),
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                )
            }
        }

        composable<AppRoutes.Subroutines> {
            FontScopeProvider(FontScope.EDITOR) {
                SubroutinesRoute(
                    viewModel = activityEditorViewModel(),
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                )
            }
        }

        composable<AppRoutes.Validation> {
            FontScopeProvider(FontScope.EDITOR) {
                ValidationIssuesRoute(
                    viewModel = activityEditorViewModel(),
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                )
            }
        }

        composable<AppRoutes.Search> {
            FontScopeProvider(FontScope.EDITOR) {
                SearchRoute(
                    viewModel = activityEditorViewModel(),
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                )
            }
        }

        composable<AppRoutes.StoryStats> {
            FontScopeProvider(FontScope.EDITOR) {
                StoryStatsRoute(
                    viewModel = activityEditorViewModel(),
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                )
            }
        }

        composable<AppRoutes.Reader> { entry ->
            val route: AppRoutes.Reader = entry.toRoute()
            val previewViewModel = activityReaderPreviewViewModel()
            val preview = route.previewId?.let(previewViewModel::get)
            val arguments = remember(route, preview) {
                buildReaderArguments(route, preview)
            }
            ReaderRoute(
                viewModel = readerViewModel(),
                arguments = arguments,
                onExit = { navController.popBackStack() },
                onNavigateToMenu = { navController.navigate(AppRoutes.Menu) },
                onNavigateToSettings = { navController.navigate(AppRoutes.Settings) },
            )
        }
    }
}

// =====================================================================
// ViewModel owners
// =====================================================================

@Composable
private fun activityEditorViewModel(): AdventureEditorViewModel {
    val activity = checkNotNull(LocalActivity.current as? ComponentActivity) {
        "AppNavHost requires a ComponentActivity host"
    }
    return viewModel(viewModelStoreOwner = activity)
}

@Composable
private fun activityReaderPreviewViewModel(): ReaderPreviewViewModel {
    val activity = checkNotNull(LocalActivity.current as? ComponentActivity) {
        "AppNavHost requires a ComponentActivity host"
    }
    return viewModel(viewModelStoreOwner = activity)
}

/** NavBackStackEntry-scoped: disposed together with the reader entry. */
@Composable
private fun readerViewModel(): AdventureReaderViewModel = viewModel()

// =====================================================================
// Helpers
// =====================================================================

private fun buildReaderArguments(
    route: AppRoutes.Reader,
    preview: EditorPreviewRequest?,
): Bundle = Bundle().apply {
    if (route.previewId != null) {
        if (preview != null) {
            putString("adventure_json", preview.adventureJson)
            putString("preview_scene_id", preview.sceneId)
            putInt("preview_chapter_index", preview.chapterIndex)
            putBoolean("preview_mode", true)
        }
    } else if (route.fileUri != null) {
        putString("adventure_file_uri", route.fileUri)
    }
}

/**
 * Library/Statistics "Меню" button: pop when possible (normal path), or
 * replace the stack with the Menu when these screens are the start
 * destination (e.g. a future deep link).
 */
private fun navigateBackOrMenu(navController: NavHostController) {
    if (navController.popBackStack()) return
    navController.navigate(AppRoutes.Menu) {
        popUpTo(navController.graph.id) { inclusive = true }
        launchSingleTop = true
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.ui

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import com.myapp.adventure.ui.editor.EditorPreviewRequest
import java.util.UUID

/**
 * Phase 4-c: holds reader-preview payloads outside the navigation route.
 *
 * The preview JSON can be large, so it must not be encoded into a typed
 * navigation route. The editor stores the payload here and navigates with a
 * short id; the reader destination resolves it back.
 *
 * Activity-scoped (survives rotation, so preview keeps working after a
 * config change). Payloads are kept for the Activity lifetime: losing a
 * preview on process death is acceptable, and the map is bounded by how
 * many previews the user opens in one session.
 */
class ReaderPreviewViewModel : ViewModel() {

    private val payloads = mutableMapOf<String, EditorPreviewRequest>()

    fun put(request: EditorPreviewRequest): String {
        val id = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        payloads[id] = request
        return id
    }

    fun get(id: String): EditorPreviewRequest? = payloads[id]
}
