package com.myapp.adventure.utils

import com.myapp.adventure.data.EditorScene
import com.myapp.adventure.data.SearchFieldType
import com.myapp.adventure.data.SearchResult
import com.myapp.adventure.R

object SearchService {

    private const val CONTEXT_LEN = 30
    private const val MIN_QUERY_LENGTH = 2

    /**
     * @param titleFallback displayed title for scenes whose `title` is
     *   blank. The caller (`SearchRoute`) passes
     *   `stringResource(R.string.label_without_title)`; `:utils` stays free
     *   of `Context` and free of user-facing strings.
     */
    fun search(
        scenes: List<EditorScene>,
        query: String,
        searchInTitles: Boolean,
        searchInTexts: Boolean,
        searchInChoices: Boolean,
        searchInTags: Boolean,
        titleFallback: String = "",
    ): List<SearchResult> {
        val trimmed = query.trim()
        if (trimmed.length < MIN_QUERY_LENGTH) return emptyList()
        val qLower = trimmed.lowercase()

        val results = mutableListOf<SearchResult>()

        for (scene in scenes) {
            val displayTitle = scene.title.ifBlank { titleFallback }

            if (searchInTitles && scene.title.isNotEmpty()) {
                val positions = findAllPositions(scene.title, qLower)
                if (positions.isNotEmpty()) {
                    results += makeResult(
                        sceneUid = scene.uid,
                        sceneTitle = displayTitle,
                        fieldType = SearchFieldType.SCENE_TITLE,
                        detailRes = R.string.search_detail_title,
                        sourceText = scene.title,
                        positions = positions,
                        matchLen = trimmed.length
                    )
                }
            }

            if (searchInTexts && scene.text.isNotEmpty()) {
                val positions = findAllPositions(scene.text, qLower)
                if (positions.isNotEmpty()) {
                    results += makeResult(
                        sceneUid = scene.uid,
                        sceneTitle = displayTitle,
                        fieldType = SearchFieldType.SCENE_TEXT,
                        detailRes = R.string.search_detail_text,
                        sourceText = scene.text,
                        positions = positions,
                        matchLen = trimmed.length
                    )
                }
            }

            if (searchInChoices) {
                scene.choices.forEachIndexed { idx, choice ->
                    if (choice.text.isEmpty()) return@forEachIndexed
                    val positions = findAllPositions(choice.text, qLower)
                    if (positions.isNotEmpty()) {
                        results += makeResult(
                            sceneUid = scene.uid,
                            sceneTitle = displayTitle,
                            fieldType = SearchFieldType.CHOICE_TEXT,
                            detailRes = R.string.search_detail_choice_fmt,
                            detailArg = idx + 1,
                            sourceText = choice.text,
                            positions = positions,
                            matchLen = trimmed.length
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

            if (searchInTags) {
                scene.tags.forEach { tag ->
                    if (tag.name.isEmpty()) return@forEach
                    val positions = findAllPositions(tag.name, qLower)
                    if (positions.isNotEmpty()) {
                        results += makeResult(
                            sceneUid = scene.uid,
                            sceneTitle = displayTitle,
                            fieldType = SearchFieldType.TAG_NAME,
                            detailRes = R.string.search_detail_tag,
                            sourceText = tag.name,
                            positions = positions,
                            matchLen = trimmed.length
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return results
    }

    private fun findAllPositions(text: String, qLower: String): List<Int> {
        val positions = mutableListOf<Int>()
        val textLower = text.lowercase()
        var idx = textLower.indexOf(qLower)
        while (idx >= 0) {
            positions += idx
            idx = textLower.indexOf(qLower, idx + 1)
        }
        return positions
    }

    private fun makeResult(
        sceneUid: String,
        sceneTitle: String,
        fieldType: SearchFieldType,
        detailRes: Int,
        sourceText: String,
        positions: List<Int>,
        matchLen: Int,
        detailArg: Int? = null,
    ): SearchResult {
        val firstPos = positions.first()

        val beforeStart = (firstPos - CONTEXT_LEN).coerceAtLeast(0)
        val before = sourceText.substring(beforeStart, firstPos).replace('\n', ' ')

        val match = sourceText.substring(firstPos, firstPos + matchLen)

        val afterEnd = (firstPos + matchLen + CONTEXT_LEN).coerceAtMost(sourceText.length)
        val after = sourceText.substring(firstPos + matchLen, afterEnd).replace('\n', ' ')

        return SearchResult(
            sceneUid = sceneUid,
            sceneTitle = sceneTitle,
            fieldType = fieldType,
            detailRes = detailRes,
            detailArg = detailArg,
            contextBefore = before,
            match = match,
            contextAfter = after,
            totalMatchesInField = positions.size,
            charOffset = firstPos
        )
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.utils

import android.content.Context
import android.net.Uri
import android.provider.DocumentsContract
import com.google.gson.Gson
import com.google.gson.JsonArray
import com.google.gson.JsonElement
import com.google.gson.JsonParser
import com.myapp.adventure.data.StepBucket
import com.myapp.adventure.data.StepHistoryData
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter

/**
 * Owns the step history. Single writer, in-memory cache, batched disk flush.
 *
 * Data model:
 * - [StepHistoryData.buckets] — up to 30 daily deltas, oldest first, trimmed automatically.
 * - [StepHistoryData.totalStepsAllTime] — monotonic counter that never trims.
 *
 * Public API for gameplay:
 * - [getTotalSteps]          — all-time monotonic counter.
 * - [getTodaySteps]          — today's delta.
 * - [getLastNDaysSum]        — rolling window sum (7 / 30 days, achievements).
 * - [getDailyBuckets]        — last N days as a list (statistics screen).
 * - [recordDelta]            — the only writer entry point, source-agnostic.
 * - [flush]                  — force-persist.
 *
 * Future features (achievements, step-gated choices, adventure unlocks) must read
 * history through the public getters above — never touch files or [StepCounterService].
 * TODO(feature:achievements): a StepAchievementEngine will subscribe to history changes
 *   (e.g. an in-process callback invoked from [recordDelta]) and evaluate rules like
 *   "≥50 000 steps in the last 7 days".
 */
object StepHistoryManager {

    private const val HISTORY_FILE_NAME = "step_history.json"
    private const val MAX_DAYS = 30
    private const val SAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS = 10_000L

    private val gson = Gson()
    private val dateFormatter: DateTimeFormatter = DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE
    private val mutex = Mutex()

    // ----- In-memory cache -----

    @Volatile private var cache: StepHistoryData = StepHistoryData()
    @Volatile private var cacheLoaded = false
    @Volatile private var lastSaveAt: Long = 0L

    // ==================== Public API ====================

    /** Total steps ever recorded by the app (monotonic, independent of buckets). */
    fun getTotalSteps(context: Context): Long {
        ensureLoaded(context)
        return cache.totalStepsAllTime
    }

    /** Steps recorded today (local date). */
    fun getTodaySteps(context: Context): Int {
        ensureLoaded(context)
        val today = LocalDate.now().format(dateFormatter)
        return cache.buckets.firstOrNull { it.date == today }?.steps ?: 0
    }

    /** Sum of the last [days] buckets (including today). */
    fun getLastNDaysSum(context: Context, days: Int): Int {
        if (days <= 0) return 0
        ensureLoaded(context)
        val cutoff = LocalDate.now()
            .minusDays((days - 1).toLong())
            .format(dateFormatter)
        return cache.buckets
            .filter { it.date >= cutoff }
            .sumOf { it.steps }
    }

    /**
     * Last [lastNDays] buckets, oldest first, padded with zero-step entries
     * for days without data. Length is exactly [lastNDays].
     */
    fun getDailyBuckets(context: Context, lastNDays: Int): List<StepBucket> {
        if (lastNDays <= 0) return emptyList()
        ensureLoaded(context)
        val today = LocalDate.now()
        val result = ArrayList<StepBucket>(lastNDays)
        for (i in (lastNDays - 1) downTo 0) {
            val date = today.minusDays(i.toLong()).format(dateFormatter)
            val existing = cache.buckets.firstOrNull { it.date == date }
            result.add(existing ?: StepBucket(date, 0))
        }
        return result
    }

    /**
     * Record a delta of [delta] steps for today.
     * Non-positive deltas are ignored. Safe to call from any coroutine context.
     */
    suspend fun recordDelta(context: Context, delta: Int) {
        if (delta <= 0) return
        val appContext = context.applicationContext
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            mutex.withLock {
                ensureLoaded(appContext)
                applyDelta(appContext, delta)
                maybeFlush(appContext)
            }
        }
    }

    /** Force writing the current in-memory state to disk. */
    suspend fun flush(context: Context) {
        val appContext = context.applicationContext
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            mutex.withLock {
                ensureLoaded(appContext)
                saveToDisk(appContext, cache)
                lastSaveAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Apply a delta coming from Health Connect.
     *
     * Same semantics as [recordDelta] — increments today's bucket and the
     * monotonic total. Kept as a separate method so callers/logs can
     * distinguish HC-sourced steps.
     */
    suspend fun applyHealthConnectDelta(context: Context, delta: Int) {
        if (delta <= 0) return
        recordDelta(context, delta)
    }

    // ==================== Internal: load / migrate ====================

    private fun ensureLoaded(context: Context) {
        if (cacheLoaded) return
        synchronized(this) {
            if (cacheLoaded) return
            cache = loadFromDisk(context)
            cacheLoaded = true
        }
    }

    private fun loadFromDisk(context: Context): StepHistoryData {
        val fileUri = getHistoryFileUri(context) ?: return StepHistoryData()
        val json: String = try {
            context.contentResolver.openInputStream(fileUri)
                ?.bufferedReader()
                ?.use { it.readText() }
                .orEmpty()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(context, "Failed to read step history: ${e.message}")
            return StepHistoryData()
        }
        if (json.isBlank()) return StepHistoryData()

        return try {
            val element = JsonParser.parseString(json)
            when {
                element.isJsonObject -> {
                    // New format: { "totalStepsAllTime": ..., "buckets": [...] }
                    gson.fromJson(element, StepHistoryData::class.java) ?: StepHistoryData()
                }
                element.isJsonArray -> {
                    // Legacy format: [["2026-11-04", 53000], ...] with absolute values
                    migrateLegacyFormat(context, element.asJsonArray)
                }
                else -> StepHistoryData()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(context, "Failed to parse step history: ${e.message}")
            StepHistoryData()
        }
    }

    /**
     * Convert legacy [["date", absoluteSteps], ...] to the new delta model.
     *
     * First bucket gets steps=0 because we don't know how many steps happened
     * before the first recorded value. [totalStepsAllTime] is set to the last
     * absolute reading — the closest approximation of "steps since phone boot",
     * which the user perceives as "all steps".
     */
    private fun migrateLegacyFormat(context: Context, array: JsonArray): StepHistoryData {
        val entries = mutableListOf<Pair<String, Int>>()
        for (el in array) {
            if (!el.isJsonArray) continue
            val pair = el.asJsonArray
            val date = safeString(pair, 0) ?: continue
            val abs = safeInt(pair, 1) ?: continue
            entries.add(date to abs)
        }
        entries.sortBy { it.first }

        val buckets = mutableListOf<StepBucket>()
        var prevAbs: Int? = null
        var lastAbs: Int = 0
        for ((date, abs) in entries) {
            val delta = if (prevAbs != null) (abs - prevAbs).coerceAtLeast(0) else 0
            buckets.add(StepBucket(date, delta))
            prevAbs = abs
            lastAbs = abs
        }
        val trimmed = trimBuckets(buckets)
        val total = lastAbs.toLong()

        Logger.log(
            context,
            "Migrated legacy step history: ${buckets.size} buckets, total=$total"
        )
        return StepHistoryData(totalStepsAllTime = total, buckets = trimmed)
    }

    private fun safeString(array: JsonArray, index: Int): String? {
        if (index < 0 || index >= array.size()) return null
        val el: JsonElement = array.get(index)
        return if (el.isJsonPrimitive) el.asString else null
    }

    private fun safeInt(array: JsonArray, index: Int): Int? {
        if (index < 0 || index >= array.size()) return null
        val el: JsonElement = array.get(index)
        return if (el.isJsonPrimitive && el.asJsonPrimitive.isNumber) el.asInt else null
    }

    // ==================== Internal: delta application ====================

    /**
     * Apply [delta] to today's bucket and bump the monotonic total.
     * Must be called under [mutex] after [ensureLoaded].
     */
    private fun applyDelta(context: Context, delta: Int) {
        if (delta <= 0) return
        val today = LocalDate.now().format(dateFormatter)
        val buckets = cache.buckets.toMutableList()
        val idx = buckets.indexOfFirst { it.date == today }
        if (idx >= 0) {
            buckets[idx] = buckets[idx].copy(steps = buckets[idx].steps + delta)
        } else {
            buckets.add(StepBucket(today, delta))
        }
        val trimmed = trimBuckets(buckets.sortedBy { it.date })
        cache = StepHistoryData(
            totalStepsAllTime = cache.totalStepsAllTime + delta,
            buckets = trimmed
        )
    }

    private fun trimBuckets(buckets: List<StepBucket>): List<StepBucket> {
        if (buckets.size <= MAX_DAYS) return buckets
        return buckets
            .sortedByDescending { it.date }
            .take(MAX_DAYS)
            .sortedBy { it.date }
    }

    // ==================== Internal: persistence ====================

    private fun maybeFlush(context: Context) {
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        if (now - lastSaveAt >= SAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS) {
            saveToDisk(context, cache)
            lastSaveAt = now
        }
    }

    private fun saveToDisk(context: Context, data: StepHistoryData) {
        val fileUri = getOrCreateHistoryFile(context)
        if (fileUri == null) {
            Logger.log(context, "Cannot save step history: no history file")
            return
        }
        try {
            val json = gson.toJson(data)
            context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(fileUri, "wt")?.use {
                it.write(json.toByteArray())
            }
            Logger.log(
                context,
                "Step history saved: ${data.buckets.size} buckets, total=${data.totalStepsAllTime}"
            )
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(context, "Failed to save step history: ${e.message}")
        }
    }

    // ==================== Internal: file access ====================

    private fun getHistoryFileUri(context: Context): Uri? {
        val folderUri = getBaseFolderUri(context) ?: return null
        val childrenUri = DocumentsContract.buildChildDocumentsUriUsingTree(
            folderUri,
            DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(folderUri)
        )
        val cursor = context.contentResolver.query(childrenUri, null, null, null, null)
        cursor?.use {
            while (it.moveToNext()) {
                val name = it.getString(
                    it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME)
                )
                if (name == HISTORY_FILE_NAME) {
                    val docId = it.getString(
                        it.getColumnIndexOrThrow(DocumentsContract.Document.COLUMN_DOCUMENT_ID)
                    )
                    return DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(folderUri, docId)
                }
            }
        }
        return null
    }

    private fun getOrCreateHistoryFile(context: Context): Uri? {
        val folderUri = getBaseFolderUri(context) ?: return null
        getHistoryFileUri(context)?.let { return it }

        val parentDocId = DocumentsContract.getTreeDocumentId(folderUri)
        val rootDocUri = DocumentsContract.buildDocumentUriUsingTree(folderUri, parentDocId)
        return try {
            DocumentsContract.createDocument(
                context.contentResolver,
                rootDocUri,
                "application/json",
                HISTORY_FILE_NAME
            )
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Logger.log(context, "Failed to create step_history.json: ${e.message}")
            null
        }
    }

    private fun getBaseFolderUri(context: Context): Uri? {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences("adventure_prefs", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        val uriString = prefs.getString("adventure_folder_uri", null) ?: return null
        return Uri.parse(uriString)
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.utils

import com.myapp.adventure.data.ChapterStats
import com.myapp.adventure.data.EditorScene
import com.myapp.adventure.data.StoryStats
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

object StoryStatsService {

    /** Average reading speed, words per minute. */
    private const val WORDS_PER_MINUTE = 200.0

    /** Extra deliberation time per choice, seconds. */
    private const val SECONDS_PER_CHOICE = 20

    /**
     * @param titleFallback displayed title for scenes whose `title` is
     *   blank. The caller (`StoryStatsRoute`) passes
     *   `stringResource(R.string.label_without_title)`; `:utils` stays free
     *   of `Context` and user-facing strings.
     */
    fun calculate(scenes: List<EditorScene>, titleFallback: String = ""): StoryStats {
        if (scenes.isEmpty()) {
            return StoryStats(
                totalScenes = 0,
                totalWords = 0,
                totalChoices = 0,
                totalChapters = 0,
                estimatedReadingMinutes = 0,
                avgWordsPerScene = 0,
                longestSceneTitle = "",
                longestSceneWords = 0,
                shortestSceneTitle = "",
                shortestSceneWords = 0,
                chapters = emptyList()
            )
        }

        val perSceneWords = scenes.map { countWords(it.text) }
        val totalWords = perSceneWords.sum()
        val totalChoices = scenes.sumOf { it.choices.size }

        // Longest and shortest scenes
        var longestIdx = 0
        var shortestIdx = 0
        for (i in perSceneWords.indices) {
            if (perSceneWords[i] > perSceneWords[longestIdx]) longestIdx = i
            if (perSceneWords[i] < perSceneWords[shortestIdx]) shortestIdx = i
        }

        // Chapter grouping — same algorithm as in buildAdventure()
        val chapters = buildChapterGroups(scenes)
        val chapterStats = chapters.mapIndexed { idx, group ->
            val isLast = idx == chapters.size - 1
            val wordCount = group.sumOf { countWords(it.text) }
            val choiceCount = group.sumOf { it.choices.size }
            // b2 TODO: gates can now sit anywhere in a chapter, not
            // just on the last scene. This heuristic (last scene's
            // gate) is the old behaviour. A proper "sum of gates in
            // chapter" or "first gate in chapter" goes into a polish
            // pass; for now it keeps the stats close enough.
            val requiredSteps = if (!isLast) group.last().gateRequiredSteps else 0
            ChapterStats(
                index = idx + 1,
                sceneCount = group.size,
                wordCount = wordCount,
                choiceCount = choiceCount,
                requiredSteps = requiredSteps,
                isLast = isLast
            )
        }

        // Reading time: words + deliberation on choices
        val readingSeconds = (totalWords / WORDS_PER_MINUTE * 60.0).roundToInt() +
                totalChoices * SECONDS_PER_CHOICE
        val readingMinutes = (readingSeconds / 60.0).roundToInt()

        val avgWords = (totalWords.toDouble() / scenes.size).roundToInt()

        return StoryStats(
            totalScenes = scenes.size,
            totalWords = totalWords,
            totalChoices = totalChoices,
            totalChapters = chapters.size,
            estimatedReadingMinutes = readingMinutes,
            avgWordsPerScene = avgWords,
            longestSceneTitle = scenes[longestIdx].title.ifBlank { titleFallback },
            longestSceneWords = perSceneWords[longestIdx],
            shortestSceneTitle = scenes[shortestIdx].title.ifBlank { titleFallback },
            shortestSceneWords = perSceneWords[shortestIdx],
            chapters = chapterStats
        )
    }

    /**
     * Считает слова: разбивает по пробельным символам, отбрасывает пустые.
     * Подходит для русского и большинства европейских языков.
     */
    private fun countWords(text: String): Int {
        if (text.isBlank()) return 0
        return text.split(Regex("\\s+")).count { it.isNotBlank() }
    }

    private fun buildChapterGroups(scenes: List<EditorScene>): List<List<EditorScene>> {
        val groups = mutableListOf<List<EditorScene>>()
        var current = mutableListOf<EditorScene>()
        for (scene in scenes) {
            current.add(scene)
            if (scene.isChapterEnd || scene == scenes.last()) {
                groups.add(current.toList())
                current = mutableListOf()
            }
        }
        if (current.isNotEmpty()) groups.add(current)
        return groups
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.utils

import androidx.annotation.StringRes
import com.myapp.adventure.R
import com.myapp.adventure.data.EditorScene
import com.myapp.adventure.data.IssueSeverity
import com.myapp.adventure.data.ValidationIssue
import com.myapp.adventure.engine.CompileError
import com.myapp.adventure.engine.CompileResult
import com.myapp.adventure.engine.Engine
import com.myapp.adventure.engine.analyze.Analyzer
import com.myapp.adventure.engine.analyze.LintIssue
import com.myapp.adventure.engine.analyze.LintKind
import com.myapp.adventure.engine.analyze.Severity
import com.myapp.adventure.engine.ir.Adventure
import com.myapp.adventure.engine.ir.types.TypeChecker
import com.myapp.adventure.engine.ir.types.TypeError

/**
 * Bridge between the editor UI and `:engine`'s validation pipeline.
 *
 * **Ф2.6.** Before Ф2.6, `StoryValidator` had its own parser and ten
 * hand-rolled checks. Nine of them duplicated what `:engine` already
 * does — but at different pipeline layers (parse / compile / analyze)
 * and with different error shapes — and one (a warning about a step
 * gate on an `isEnding` scene) was **wrong**: the reader handles gates
 * on ending scenes correctly (gate first, then `onGatePassed` checks
 * `isEnding`), so warning "the gate will not fire" was misleading.
 *
 * After Ф2.6, this object is a thin **bridge**: it takes the editor's
 * `Adventure` (built by `AdventureEditorViewModel.buildAdventure()`)
 * and runs the exact pipeline the reader will run:
 *
 * 1. [TypeChecker.check] — unknown variables, wrong types (Ф2.2),
 *    subroutine local scopes and call types (Ф4.7).
 * 2. [Engine.compile] — duplicate scene ids, missing start scene,
 *    dangling `nextScene` (Ф1.5.5.1 / Ф1.6.2.1), subroutine refs,
 *    arity and cycles (Ф4.7).
 * 3. [Analyzer.lint] — reachability, dead ends, unestablished items,
 *    contradictory endings (Ф1.6), dead conditions (Ф3.6), merge
 *    conflicts (Ф4.6).
 *
 * The result is a `List<ValidationIssue>` ready for the editor's
 * validation dialog. The author sees **the same errors** that the
 * player would hit on open — not a similar-but-different set produced
 * by a parallel implementation.
 *
 * **Why `scenes: List<EditorScene>` is still passed.** The engine
 * reports problems by `SceneId` (the on-disk id). The editor's
 * navigation ("click the issue → jump to the scene") works by
 * `EditorScene.uid` (a per-scene UUID that survives renaming).
 * `StoryValidator` maps `SceneId.value` → `EditorScene.uid` once and
 * fills `ValidationIssue.sceneUid`. When the id is not in the map
 * (e.g. an `InitialState` error with `sceneId == null`), `sceneUid`
 * is `""` — the dialog's click handler is a no-op for that issue.
 *
 * **What this object does NOT do.**
 * - It does not parse conditions (Ф2.6 DoD: grep `extractHasFlagName`
 *   = 0, `StoryValidator` has no `ConditionParser`).
 * - It does not compute reachability (`Analyzer.reachable` owns it).
 * - It does not know about step gates on ending scenes — that
 *   combination works at runtime and produces no issue.
 *
 * **Deleted in Ф2.6** (and why):
 * - Checks #1–#9 — fully duplicated `:engine`:
 *   - #1 "empty choice text" — `ParseError.Structure` (JsonToIr).
 *   - #2 "choice without next_scene" — `ParseError.Structure`.
 *   - #3 "dangling next_scene" — `CompileError.MissingNextScene`.
 *   - #4 "condition on unestablished flag" — `LintKind.ConditionOnUnestablishedFlag`.
 *   - #5 "removing unestablished item" — `LintKind.RemovingUnestablishedItem`.
 *   - #6 "death scene without health" — `LintKind.DeathSceneWithoutHealth`.
 *   - #7 "death without death scene" — `LintKind.DeathWithoutDeathScene`.
 *   - #8 "dead end" — `LintKind.DeadEnd`.
 *   - #9 "unreachable scene" — `LintKind.UnreachableScene`.
 * - Check #10 "step gate on an ending scene" — **wrong**, removed
 *   without replacement. The reader's `loadCurrentScene` checks
 *   `scene.gate` before `scene.isEnding`; `onGatePassed` then
 *   evaluates `isEnding`. A gated ending is a legitimate mechanic
 *   ("walk N steps to reach the final scene").
 * - `extractHasFlagName` — the last piece of condition parsing in
 *   `:app`. Ф2.6 DoD: 0 occurrences.
 */
object StoryValidator {

    /**
     * Validates [adventure] against the reader's pipeline.
     *
     * @param adventure the IR built by the editor (via
     *   `AdventureEditorViewModel.buildAdventure()`). Should be built
     *   **after** `freezeAllPendingIds()` — see `ValidationIssuesRoute`
     *   — so that pending scene IDs are stable.
     * @param scenes the editor scenes, used only to map
     *   `SceneId.value` → `EditorScene.uid` for UI navigation.
     * @return issues in the order they were found. Type errors first,
     *   then compile errors (if any — otherwise lint), then lint
     *   issues. Each issue's `sceneUid` is `""` when the underlying
     *   engine error has no scene (e.g. `InitialState` type errors,
     *   `MissingStartScene`).
     */
    fun validate(
        adventure: Adventure,
        scenes: List<EditorScene>,
    ): List<ValidationIssue> {
        val uidBySceneId: Map<String, String> = scenes
            .filter { it.id.isNotEmpty() }
            .associate { it.id to it.uid }

        val issues = mutableListOf<ValidationIssue>()

        // 1. Type checking (Ф2.2). Usually empty — the editor builds a
        //    mostly-valid Adventure — but a typo in a condition or a
        //    stat-effect on a Bool is easy to make and impossible to
        //    see without this.
        for (typeError in TypeChecker.check(adventure)) {
            issues += ValidationIssue(
                severity = IssueSeverity.ERROR,
                sceneUid = typeError.sceneId?.let { uidBySceneId[it.value] } ?: "",
                titleRes = titleFor(typeError),
                description = typeError.message,
            )
        }

        // 2. Compile. If the file cannot be compiled, lint is not run —
        //    same short-circuit as `JsonToIr.parse` → `TypeChecker` in
        //    Ф2.3. A `CompiledAdventure` cannot even be built, so
        //    `Analyzer.reachable` / `Analyzer.lint` have nothing to
        //    work on.
        when (val compileResult = Engine.compile(adventure)) {
            is CompileResult.Failure -> {
                for (compileError in compileResult.errors) {
                    issues += ValidationIssue(
                        severity = IssueSeverity.ERROR,
                        sceneUid = sceneUidOf(compileError, uidBySceneId),
                        titleRes = titleFor(compileError),
                        description = compileError.message,
                    )
                }
            }
            is CompileResult.Success -> {
                // 3. Lint (Ф1.6). `Severity.INFO` issues are not shown
                //    in the editor validation dialog — they are
                //    informational, not actionable. If a future
                //    `LintKind` gains an INFO variant that *is*
                //    actionable, teach this `when` to render it.
                for (lintIssue in Analyzer.lint(compileResult.compiled)) {
                    val severity = when (lintIssue.severity) {
                        Severity.ERROR -> IssueSeverity.ERROR
                        Severity.WARNING -> IssueSeverity.WARNING
                        Severity.INFO -> continue
                    }
                    issues += ValidationIssue(
                        severity = severity,
                        sceneUid = lintIssue.sceneId?.let { uidBySceneId[it.value] } ?: "",
                        titleRes = titleFor(lintIssue),
                        description = lintIssue.message,
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        return issues
    }

    // ---------- Scene id → editor uid ----------

    private fun sceneUidOf(
        compileError: CompileError,
        uidBySceneId: Map<String, String>,
    ): String = when (compileError) {
        is CompileError.DuplicateSceneId ->
            uidBySceneId[compileError.sceneId.value] ?: ""
        is CompileError.MissingStartScene -> ""
        is CompileError.MissingNextScene ->
            uidBySceneId[compileError.sceneId.value] ?: ""
        is CompileError.MissingMergeSource ->
            uidBySceneId[compileError.sceneId.value] ?: ""
        is CompileError.DuplicateSubroutineId -> ""
        is CompileError.MissingSubroutine ->
            compileError.sceneId?.let { uidBySceneId[it.value] } ?: ""
        is CompileError.InvalidSubroutineCall ->
            compileError.sceneId?.let { uidBySceneId[it.value] } ?: ""
        is CompileError.SubroutineCycle -> ""
    }

    // ---------- Titles (Russian UI) ----------
    //
    // Why titles live here, not in :engine: LintKind / TypeError are
    // language-agnostic. The Russian title is a UI concern of the
    // editor dialog. Keeping the `when` exhaustive means: adding a new
    // LintKind / TypeError in :engine breaks `:app` compilation until
    // someone adds a title here — intentional, no silent English text
    // sneaking into a Russian-language dialog.

    @StringRes
    private fun titleFor(typeError: TypeError): Int = when (typeError) {
        is TypeError.UnknownVariable -> R.string.validation_title_unknown_variable
        is TypeError.HasOnNonBool -> R.string.validation_title_has_on_non_bool
        is TypeError.SetFlagOnNonBool -> R.string.validation_title_set_flag_on_non_bool
        is TypeError.RemoveFlagOnNonBool -> R.string.validation_title_remove_flag_on_non_bool
        is TypeError.ModifyStatOnNonNumeric -> R.string.validation_title_modify_stat_on_non_numeric
        is TypeError.CompareOnNonNumeric -> R.string.validation_title_compare_on_non_numeric
        is TypeError.InRangeOnNonNumeric -> R.string.validation_title_in_range_on_non_numeric
        is TypeError.InitialFlagOnNonBool -> R.string.validation_title_initial_flag_on_non_bool
        is TypeError.InitialStatOnNonNumeric -> R.string.validation_title_initial_stat_on_non_numeric
        is TypeError.InSubroutine -> titleFor(typeError.cause)
        is TypeError.InvalidSubroutineSignature -> R.string.validation_title_subroutine_signature
    }

    @StringRes
    private fun titleFor(compileError: CompileError): Int = when (compileError) {
        is CompileError.DuplicateSceneId -> R.string.validation_title_duplicate_scene_id
        is CompileError.MissingStartScene -> R.string.validation_title_missing_start_scene
        is CompileError.MissingNextScene -> R.string.validation_title_missing_next_scene
        is CompileError.MissingMergeSource -> R.string.validation_title_missing_merge_source
        is CompileError.DuplicateSubroutineId -> R.string.validation_title_duplicate_subroutine_id
        is CompileError.MissingSubroutine -> R.string.validation_title_missing_subroutine
        is CompileError.InvalidSubroutineCall -> R.string.validation_title_invalid_subroutine_call
        is CompileError.SubroutineCycle -> R.string.validation_title_subroutine_cycle
    }

    @StringRes
    private fun titleFor(lintIssue: LintIssue): Int = when (val kind = lintIssue.kind) {
        is LintKind.UnreachableScene -> R.string.validation_title_unreachable_scene
        is LintKind.RemovingUnestablishedItem -> R.string.validation_title_removing_unestablished_item
        is LintKind.DeathSceneWithoutHealth -> R.string.validation_title_death_scene_without_health
        is LintKind.ConditionOnUnestablishedFlag -> R.string.validation_title_condition_on_unestablished_flag
        is LintKind.DeathWithoutDeathScene -> R.string.validation_title_death_without_death_scene
        is LintKind.DeadEnd -> R.string.validation_title_dead_end
        is LintKind.EndingSceneWithChoices -> R.string.validation_title_ending_scene_with_choices
        is LintKind.UnreachableInvariant -> R.string.validation_title_unreachable_invariant
        is LintKind.DeadCondition -> R.string.validation_title_dead_condition
        is LintKind.MergeConflict -> when (kind.reason) {
            LintKind.MergeConflict.Reason.NoIncomingBranches ->
                R.string.validation_title_merge_no_incoming
            LintKind.MergeConflict.Reason.SourceDoesNotLeadHere ->
                R.string.validation_title_merge_source_not_linked
            LintKind.MergeConflict.Reason.SourceNotReachable ->
                R.string.validation_title_merge_source_unreachable
        }
    }
}

FILE: app/src/main/java/com/myapp/adventure/utils/ThemeManager.kt

package com.myapp.adventure.utils

import android.app.Activity
import android.content.Context
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDelegate
import com.myapp.adventure.R
import com.myapp.adventure.data.theme.AppThemeConfig
import com.myapp.adventure.data.theme.BuiltInThemes
import com.myapp.adventure.data.theme.ThemeDataStore
import com.myapp.adventure.data.theme.ThemeRepository
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking

/**
 * Thin facade over [ThemeRepository], kept for two reasons:
 *
 *  1. It exposes a stable API (`getMode`, `setMode`, `apply`) used by
 *     `MainActivity` and `SettingsScreen`; callers do not touch DataStore,
 *     coroutines, or serialization.
 *  2. It maps a theme id to the Activity's `styleRes` and applies
 *     `AppCompatDelegate` night mode. Compose screens read the full
 *     `AppThemeConfig` through `AdventureTheme`.
 *
 * Lifecycle:
 *  - `initialize(context)` — call once per process, from `MainActivity.onCreate`
 *    **before** `super.onCreate()`. Idempotent.
 *  - `awaitInitialized()` — call right after `initialize`, inside `runBlocking`,
 *    to make sure the DataStore cache is warm before `apply()` reads it.
 *  - `apply(activity)` — call **before** `super.onCreate()`.
 *  - The other methods are safe to call at any time after `initialize`.
 */
object ThemeManager {

    /**
     * Mapping theme id -> View-style resource. Mirrors `BuiltInThemes.all`:
     * each built-in theme must have a matching `<style>` and an entry here.
     * Once user-authored themes exist, they will also need a generated
     * `styleRes` — a problem for a later phase, not this one.
     */
    private val styleRegistry: Map<String, Int> = mapOf(
        "default" to R.style.Theme_Adventure,
    )
    private val defaultStyleRes: Int = styleRegistry.getValue("default")

    @Volatile
    private var repository: ThemeRepository? = null

    /** Application-scoped; survives activity recreation. */
    private val scope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO + SupervisorJob())

    enum class Mode(val nightMode: Int) {
        SYSTEM(AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_FOLLOW_SYSTEM),
        LIGHT(AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_NO),
        DARK(AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_YES);

        companion object {
            fun fromNightMode(value: Int): Mode =
                entries.firstOrNull { it.nightMode == value } ?: SYSTEM
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Lifecycle
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Creates the singleton [ThemeRepository] backed by DataStore.
     * Idempotent: repeated calls (activity recreation) are no-ops.
     */
    fun initialize(context: Context) {
        if (repository == null) {
            synchronized(this) {
                if (repository == null) {
                    val appContext = context.applicationContext
                    val dataStore = ThemeDataStore.create(appContext)
                    repository = ThemeRepository(dataStore, scope)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Suspends until the initial DataStore read has populated the cache.
     * Safe to call repeatedly: returns immediately after the first call.
     */
    suspend fun awaitInitialized() {
        repository?.awaitInitialized()
    }

    private fun requireRepository(): ThemeRepository =
        repository ?: error(
            "ThemeManager.initialize(context) must be called before accessing themes"
        )

    /**
     * Returns the current [AppThemeConfig] synchronously. Falls back to
     * [BuiltInThemes.DEFAULT] when the repository has not been initialized
     * yet — this keeps Compose previews and early compositions working
     * even before `MainActivity.onCreate` runs.
     */
    fun currentThemeSync(): AppThemeConfig =
        repository?.currentTheme?.value ?: BuiltInThemes.DEFAULT

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Theme id axis
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    fun getThemeId(@Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") context: Context): String =
        requireRepository().getThemeIdSync()

    fun setThemeId(@Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") context: Context, themeId: String) {
        runBlocking { requireRepository().setThemeId(themeId) }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Night-mode axis
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    fun getNightMode(@Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") context: Context): Int =
        requireRepository().getNightModeSync()

    fun setNightMode(@Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") context: Context, nightMode: Int) {
        runBlocking { requireRepository().setNightMode(nightMode) }
        AppCompatDelegate.setDefaultNightMode(nightMode)
    }

    fun setTheme(
        @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") context: Context,
        themeId: String,
        nightMode: Int,
    ) {
        runBlocking { requireRepository().setTheme(themeId, nightMode) }
        AppCompatDelegate.setDefaultNightMode(nightMode)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Enum helpers (used by SettingsScreen)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    fun getMode(context: Context): Mode = Mode.fromNightMode(getNightMode(context))

    fun setMode(context: Context, mode: Mode) = setNightMode(context, mode.nightMode)

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Application entry point
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * Applies the persisted night mode and theme style to [activity].
     *
     * MUST be called **before** `super.onCreate()`. AppCompat reads the
     * night mode and theme during `onCreate`, so changing them afterwards
     * forces a flash or a spurious `recreate()`. Safe to call even if
     * [initialize] was not called: falls back to system night mode and the
     * default style.
     */
    fun apply(activity: Activity) {
        val repo = repository
        val nightMode = repo?.getNightModeSync()
            ?: AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_FOLLOW_SYSTEM
        val themeId = repo?.getThemeIdSync() ?: "default"

        AppCompatDelegate.setDefaultNightMode(nightMode)
        activity.setTheme(styleRegistry[themeId] ?: defaultStyleRes)
    }
}

    has one obvious home. Prefixes:
      app_         — application-wide
      menu_        — main menu
      library_     — adventure list
      editor_      — editor toolbar / save status / dialogs / toasts
      editor_scene_ / editor_choice_ / editor_tag_ / editor_steps_ /
      editor_chapter_ / editor_stats_ / editor_search_
      template_    — template list and edit dialog

      logs_        — log viewer
      search_      — search dialog (shared)

      var_kind_    — VarKind display names

      scene_picker_/ scene_no_id

        Base theme: maps Material 3 attrs to semantic tokens. Because every
        token has a values-night variant, this single style works in both
        light and dark mode, so a values-night/themes.xml override is not
        needed.

        To add a new theme later (Ocean, Sepia, ...):
          - add a style named "Theme.Adventure.Ocean" inheriting from
            "Base.Theme.Adventure", overriding the tokens that differ
            from the default palette;
          - register the styleRes in ThemeManager.registry.

        XML attribute names for the inverse roles follow the View-material
        convention (colorSurfaceInverse / colorOnSurfaceInverse /
        colorPrimaryInverse), which is the reverse word order compared to
        the Compose ColorScheme fields (inverseSurface / inverseOnSurface /
        inversePrimary). The token names in @color/md_inverse_* stay the
        same — only the attribute name on the left differs.

        Scrim has no XML theme attribute in Material 3; it is exposed only
        via Compose's ColorScheme.scrim (see ThemeManager.getColorScheme()).
    -->
    <style name="Base.Theme.Adventure" parent="Theme.Material3.DayNight.NoActionBar">

        <!-- Primary -->
        <item name="colorPrimary">@color/md_primary</item>
        <item name="colorOnPrimary">@color/md_on_primary</item>
        <item name="colorPrimaryContainer">@color/md_primary_container</item>
        <item name="colorOnPrimaryContainer">@color/md_on_primary_container</item>

        <!-- Secondary -->
        <item name="colorSecondary">@color/md_secondary</item>
        <item name="colorOnSecondary">@color/md_on_secondary</item>
        <item name="colorSecondaryContainer">@color/md_secondary_container</item>
        <item name="colorOnSecondaryContainer">@color/md_on_secondary_container</item>

        <!-- Tertiary -->
        <item name="colorTertiary">@color/md_tertiary</item>
        <item name="colorOnTertiary">@color/md_on_tertiary</item>
        <item name="colorTertiaryContainer">@color/md_tertiary_container</item>
        <item name="colorOnTertiaryContainer">@color/md_on_tertiary_container</item>

        <!-- Background / Surface -->
        <item name="android:colorBackground">@color/md_background</item>
        <item name="colorOnBackground">@color/md_on_background</item>
        <item name="colorSurface">@color/md_surface</item>
        <item name="colorOnSurface">@color/md_on_surface</item>
        <item name="colorSurfaceVariant">@color/md_surface_variant</item>
        <item name="colorOnSurfaceVariant">@color/md_on_surface_variant</item>

        <!-- Inverse (note: reverse word order vs Compose ColorScheme) -->
        <item name="colorSurfaceInverse">@color/md_inverse_surface</item>
        <item name="colorOnSurfaceInverse">@color/md_inverse_on_surface</item>
        <item name="colorPrimaryInverse">@color/md_inverse_primary</item>

FILE: app/src/test/java/com/myapp/adventure/data/AdventureSubroutineSerializationTest.kt

package com.myapp.adventure.data

import com.google.gson.Gson
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

/**
 * Ф4.8: subroutines and `Choice.call` must survive the Gson round-trip
 * used by `saveAdventureToFile` → `loadAdventureFromUri`. The engine
 * parser has its own tests; this pins the editor's wire names
 * (`subroutines`, `subroutine_id`, `set_flags`, …).
 */
class AdventureSubroutineSerializationTest {

    private val gson = Gson()

    @Test
    fun choiceCallRoundTrips() {
        val choice = Choice(
            text = "Выпить зелье",
            nextScene = "start",
            call = SubroutineCallDto(
                subroutineId = "consume",
                args = mapOf("item" to "potion", "health" to "health"),
                outputs = mapOf("item" to "potion", "health" to "health"),
            ),
        )

        val json = gson.toJson(choice)
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"subroutine_id\":\"consume\""))
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"args\""))

        val back = gson.fromJson(json, Choice::class.java)
        assertNotNull(back.call)
        val call = back.call!!
        assertEquals("consume", call.subroutineId)
        assertEquals(mapOf("item" to "potion", "health" to "health"), call.args)
        assertEquals(mapOf("item" to "potion", "health" to "health"), call.outputs)
    }

    @Test
    fun subroutineRoundTripsWithFlatBodyAndNestedCall() {
        val subroutine = SubroutineDto(
            id = "consume",
            inputs = listOf(VarDeclDto("item", "item_count")),
            outputs = listOf(VarDeclDto("item", "item_count")),
            body = listOf(
                SubroutineStepDto(
                    condition = "item > 0",
                    modifyStats = mapOf("item" to -1),
                    call = SubroutineCallDto(
                        subroutineId = "inner",
                        args = mapOf("x" to "item"),
                        outputs = mapOf("y" to "item"),
                    ),
                ),
            ),
        )
        val adventure = Adventure(
            version = 5,
            title = "T",
            subroutines = listOf(subroutine),
            chapters = emptyList(),
        )

        val json = gson.toJson(adventure)
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"subroutines\""))
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"subroutine_id\":\"inner\""))

        val back = gson.fromJson(json, Adventure::class.java)
        assertNotNull(back.subroutines)
        val sub = back.subroutines!!.single()
        assertEquals("consume", sub.id)
        assertEquals("item", sub.inputs?.single()?.name)
        assertNotNull(sub.body)
        val step = sub.body!!.single()
        assertEquals("item > 0", step.condition)
        assertEquals(mapOf("item" to -1), step.modifyStats)
        assertEquals("inner", step.call?.subroutineId)
        assertEquals(mapOf("x" to "item"), step.call?.args)
        assertEquals(mapOf("y" to "item"), step.call?.outputs)
    }

    @Test
    fun absentSubroutinesStayAbsent() {
        val adventure = Adventure(
            version = 5,
            title = "T",
            chapters = emptyList(),
        )

        val json = gson.toJson(adventure)
        assertTrue(!json.contains("\"subroutines\""))
        assertEquals(null, gson.fromJson(json, Adventure::class.java).subroutines)
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.data.theme

import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class AppThemeConfigSerializationTest {

    private val json = Json {
        prettyPrint = true
        ignoreUnknownKeys = true   // forward-compat: future fields don't break old readers
        encodeDefaults = false     // keep JSON minimal
    }

    // A minimal but valid config, all colours opaque, other fields default.
    private fun sampleConfig(): AppThemeConfig {
        val colors = ThemeColors(
            primary = 0xFF5D4037L,
            onPrimary = 0xFFFFFFFFL,
            primaryContainer = 0xFFE8D5C4L,
            onPrimaryContainer = 0xFF3E2723L,
            secondary = 0xFF795548L,
            onSecondary = 0xFFFFFFFFL,
            secondaryContainer = 0xFFEFE0D0L,
            onSecondaryContainer = 0xFF2E1A0FL,
            tertiary = 0xFF8D6E63L,
            onTertiary = 0xFFFFFFFFL,
            tertiaryContainer = 0xFFF0E0D0L,
            onTertiaryContainer = 0xFF2E1A0FL,
            background = 0xFFFAF5EAL,
            onBackground = 0xFF1C1410L,
            surface = 0xFFFAF5EAL,
            onSurface = 0xFF1C1410L,
            surfaceVariant = 0xFFEFE5D5L,
            onSurfaceVariant = 0xFF5D4037L,
            inverseSurface = 0xFF33261EL,
            inverseOnSurface = 0xFFF5E6D3L,
            inversePrimary = 0xFFD7CCC8L,
            error = 0xFFB3261EL,
            onError = 0xFFFFFFFFL,
            errorContainer = 0xFFF9DEDCL,
            onErrorContainer = 0xFF410E0BL,
            outline = 0xFFA1887FL,
            outlineVariant = 0xFFD7CCC8L,
            scrim = 0xFF000000L,
            statusSuccess = 0xFF2E6F3AL,
            statusWarning = 0xFF8F5000L,
            statusDanger = 0xFFC62828L,
            statusInfo = 0xFF1565C0L,
            statusNeutral = 0xFF5D4037L,
        )
        return AppThemeConfig(
            id = "default",
            displayName = "Adventure",
            isBuiltIn = true,
            light = colors,
            dark = colors, // same for this test — roundtrip doesn't care
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun `roundtrip preserves all colour values`() {
        val original = sampleConfig()
        val encoded = json.encodeToString(AppThemeConfig.serializer(), original)
        val decoded = json.decodeFromString(AppThemeConfig.serializer(), encoded)
        assertEquals(original, decoded)
    }

    @Test
    fun `serialized colours are human-readable hex`() {
        val encoded = json.encodeToString(AppThemeConfig.serializer(), sampleConfig())
        assertTrue("JSON should contain #5D4037", encoded.contains("#5D4037"))
        assertTrue("JSON should contain #FAF5EA", encoded.contains("#FAF5EA"))
        // Opaque colours must NOT be prefixed with alpha
        assertTrue(
            "Opaque colour must not serialize as #FF-prefixed",
            !encoded.contains("#FF5D4037"),
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun `translucent colour roundtrips with ARGB format`() {
        val translucent = 0x80FF0000L // 50% red
        val cfg = sampleConfig().let {
            it.copy(
                light = it.light.copy(primary = translucent),
                dark = it.dark.copy(primary = translucent),
            )
        }
        val encoded = json.encodeToString(AppThemeConfig.serializer(), cfg)
        assertTrue("Translucent must serialize as 8-digit hex", encoded.contains("#80FF0000"))
        val decoded = json.decodeFromString(AppThemeConfig.serializer(), encoded)
        assertEquals(translucent, decoded.light.primary)
    }

    @Test
    fun `short hex is accepted on decode`() {
        val minimalJson = """
            {
              "id": "test",
              "displayName": "Test",
              "light": {
                "primary": "#112233", "onPrimary": "#FFFFFF",
                "primaryContainer": "#000000", "onPrimaryContainer": "#FFFFFF",
                "secondary": "#000000", "onSecondary": "#FFFFFF",
                "secondaryContainer": "#000000", "onSecondaryContainer": "#FFFFFF",
                "tertiary": "#000000", "onTertiary": "#FFFFFF",
                "tertiaryContainer": "#000000", "onTertiaryContainer": "#FFFFFF",
                "background": "#FFFFFF", "onBackground": "#000000",
                "surface": "#FFFFFF", "onSurface": "#000000",
                "surfaceVariant": "#EEEEEE", "onSurfaceVariant": "#000000",
                "inverseSurface": "#000000", "inverseOnSurface": "#FFFFFF",
                "inversePrimary": "#FFFFFF",
                "error": "#FF0000", "onError": "#FFFFFF",
                "errorContainer": "#FFDDDD", "onErrorContainer": "#000000",
                "outline": "#888888", "outlineVariant": "#CCCCCC",
                "scrim": "#000000",
                "statusSuccess": "#00AA00", "statusWarning": "#AA8800",
                "statusDanger": "#AA0000", "statusInfo": "#0000AA",
                "statusNeutral": "#666666"
              },
              "dark": {
                "primary": "#112233", "onPrimary": "#FFFFFF",
                "primaryContainer": "#000000", "onPrimaryContainer": "#FFFFFF",
                "secondary": "#000000", "onSecondary": "#FFFFFF",
                "secondaryContainer": "#000000", "onSecondaryContainer": "#FFFFFF",
                "tertiary": "#000000", "onTertiary": "#FFFFFF",
                "tertiaryContainer": "#000000", "onTertiaryContainer": "#FFFFFF",
                "background": "#FFFFFF", "onBackground": "#000000",
                "surface": "#FFFFFF", "onSurface": "#000000",
                "surfaceVariant": "#EEEEEE", "onSurfaceVariant": "#000000",
                "inverseSurface": "#000000", "inverseOnSurface": "#FFFFFF",
                "inversePrimary": "#FFFFFF",
                "error": "#FF0000", "onError": "#FFFFFF",
                "errorContainer": "#FFDDDD", "onErrorContainer": "#000000",
                "outline": "#888888", "outlineVariant": "#CCCCCC",
                "scrim": "#000000",
                "statusSuccess": "#00AA00", "statusWarning": "#AA8800",
                "statusDanger": "#AA0000", "statusInfo": "#0000AA",
                "statusNeutral": "#666666"
              }
            }
        """.trimIndent()
        val cfg = json.decodeFromString(AppThemeConfig.serializer(), minimalJson)
        assertEquals(0xFF112233L, cfg.light.primary)
    }

    @Test(expected = IllegalArgumentException::class)
    fun `invalid id is rejected`() {
        sampleConfig().copy(id = "Default Theme!") // space and !
    }

    @Test(expected = IllegalArgumentException::class)
    fun `blank display name is rejected`() {
        sampleConfig().copy(displayName = "   ")
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.data.theme

import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.math.max
import kotlin.math.min
import kotlin.math.pow

class BuiltInThemesTest {

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Structural invariants
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    @Test
    fun `default theme has expected id and is built-in`() {
        assertEquals("default", BuiltInThemes.DEFAULT.id)
        assertTrue(BuiltInThemes.DEFAULT.isBuiltIn)
    }

    @Test
    fun `all built-in ids are unique`() {
        val ids = BuiltInThemes.all.map { it.id }
        assertEquals(ids.size, ids.distinct().size)
    }

    @Test
    fun `byId returns the matching preset`() {
        assertNotNull(BuiltInThemes.byId("default"))
        assertNull(BuiltInThemes.byId("nonexistent_theme"))
    }

    @Test
    fun `default is present in all`() {
        assertTrue(BuiltInThemes.all.contains(BuiltInThemes.DEFAULT))
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Completeness — no zero (i.e. fully transparent black) slipped through
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    @Test

        val cfg = BuiltInThemes.DEFAULT
        // A value of 0L means "no colour set", which is never intentional in
        // a shipped preset. Every palette entry must have full alpha at least.
        val zeros = listOf(

            "light.background" to cfg.light.background,
            "light.onBackground" to cfg.light.onBackground,
            "light.surface" to cfg.light.surface,
            "light.onSurface" to cfg.light.onSurface,
            "light.surfaceVariant" to cfg.light.surfaceVariant,
            "light.onSurfaceVariant" to cfg.light.onSurfaceVariant,
            "light.inverseSurface" to cfg.light.inverseSurface,
            "light.inverseOnSurface" to cfg.light.inverseOnSurface,
            "light.inversePrimary" to cfg.light.inversePrimary,
            "light.error" to cfg.light.error,
            "light.onError" to cfg.light.onError,
            "light.errorContainer" to cfg.light.errorContainer,
            "light.onErrorContainer" to cfg.light.onErrorContainer,
            "light.outline" to cfg.light.outline,
            "light.outlineVariant" to cfg.light.outlineVariant,
            "light.scrim" to cfg.light.scrim,
            "light.statusSuccess" to cfg.light.statusSuccess,
            "light.statusWarning" to cfg.light.statusWarning,
            "light.statusDanger" to cfg.light.statusDanger,
            "light.statusInfo" to cfg.light.statusInfo,
            "light.statusNeutral" to cfg.light.statusNeutral,
            "dark.primary" to cfg.dark.primary,
            "dark.onPrimary" to cfg.dark.onPrimary,
            "dark.primaryContainer" to cfg.dark.primaryContainer,
            "dark.onPrimaryContainer" to cfg.dark.onPrimaryContainer,
            "dark.secondary" to cfg.dark.secondary,
            "dark.onSecondary" to cfg.dark.onSecondary,
            "dark.secondaryContainer" to cfg.dark.secondaryContainer,
            "dark.onSecondaryContainer" to cfg.dark.onSecondaryContainer,
            "dark.tertiary" to cfg.dark.tertiary,
            "dark.onTertiary" to cfg.dark.onTertiary,
            "dark.tertiaryContainer" to cfg.dark.tertiaryContainer,
            "dark.onTertiaryContainer" to cfg.dark.onTertiaryContainer,
            "dark.background" to cfg.dark.background,
            "dark.onBackground" to cfg.dark.onBackground,
            "dark.surface" to cfg.dark.surface,
            "dark.onSurface" to cfg.dark.onSurface,
            "dark.surfaceVariant" to cfg.dark.surfaceVariant,
            "dark.onSurfaceVariant" to cfg.dark.onSurfaceVariant,
            "dark.inverseSurface" to cfg.dark.inverseSurface,
            "dark.inverseOnSurface" to cfg.dark.inverseOnSurface,
            "dark.inversePrimary" to cfg.dark.inversePrimary,

        zeros.forEach { (name, value) ->
            assertTrue("$name must not be 0x00000000", value != 0L)
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // WCAG contrast checks — every built-in theme must be readable.
    // Adding a new theme to BuiltInThemes.all automatically inherits
    // these checks. See https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG21/#dfn-contrast-ratio
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    @Test
    fun `default theme passes WCAG text contrast`() {
        BuiltInThemes.all.forEach { cfg ->
            assertContrastPair("${cfg.id}.light primary/onPrimary", cfg.light.primary, cfg.light.onPrimary, 4.5)
            assertContrastPair("${cfg.id}.light surface/onSurface", cfg.light.surface, cfg.light.onSurface, 4.5)
            assertContrastPair("${cfg.id}.light surface/onSurfaceVariant", cfg.light.surface, cfg.light.onSurfaceVariant, 3.0)
            assertContrastPair("${cfg.id}.light error/onError", cfg.light.error, cfg.light.onError, 4.5)

            assertContrastPair("${cfg.id}.dark primary/onPrimary", cfg.dark.primary, cfg.dark.onPrimary, 4.5)
            assertContrastPair("${cfg.id}.dark surface/onSurface", cfg.dark.surface, cfg.dark.onSurface, 4.5)
            assertContrastPair("${cfg.id}.dark surface/onSurfaceVariant", cfg.dark.surface, cfg.dark.onSurfaceVariant, 3.0)
            assertContrastPair("${cfg.id}.dark error/onError", cfg.dark.error, cfg.dark.onError, 4.5)
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Roundtrip — built-in themes must survive JSON round-trip (needed for
    // future "export built-in as a template for a custom theme" flows).
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    @Test
    fun `default theme survives JSON roundtrip`() {
        val json = Json { prettyPrint = false; encodeDefaults = true }
        val encoded = json.encodeToString(AppThemeConfig.serializer(), BuiltInThemes.DEFAULT)
        val decoded = json.decodeFromString(AppThemeConfig.serializer(), encoded)
        assertEquals(BuiltInThemes.DEFAULT, decoded)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Helpers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    private fun assertContrastPair(name: String, fg: Long, bg: Long, minRatio: Double) {
        val ratio = contrastRatio(fg, bg)
        assertTrue(
            "%s contrast %.2f:1 is below %.1f:1".format(name, ratio, minRatio),
            ratio >= minRatio,
        )
    }

    private fun contrastRatio(a: Long, b: Long): Double {
        val la = relativeLuminance(a)
        val lb = relativeLuminance(b)
        val lighter = max(la, lb)
        val darker = min(la, lb)
        return (lighter + 0.05) / (darker + 0.05)
    }

    private fun relativeLuminance(argb: Long): Double {
        fun channel(c: Int): Double {
            val s = c / 255.0
            return if (s <= 0.03928) s / 12.92 else ((s + 0.055) / 1.055).pow(2.4)
        }
        val r = channel(((argb shr 16) and 0xFF).toInt())
        val g = channel(((argb shr 8) and 0xFF).toInt())
        val b = channel((argb and 0xFF).toInt())
        return 0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b
    }
}

package com.myapp.adventure.data.theme

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatDelegate
import androidx.datastore.core.DataStore
import androidx.datastore.core.DataStoreFactory
import androidx.datastore.core.okio.OkioStorage
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.Preferences
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.PreferencesSerializer
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.edit
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.cancel
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.TestScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.UnconfinedTestDispatcher
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.runTest
import okio.FileSystem
import okio.Path.Companion.toOkioPath
import org.junit.After
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder
import java.io.File

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
class ThemeRepositoryTest {

    @get:Rule val tempFolder = TemporaryFolder()

    private lateinit var dataStoreScope: CoroutineScope

    /**
     * Creates a DataStore backed by [OkioStorage] explicitly. This bypasses
     * the platform-specific [androidx.datastore.preferences.core.PreferenceDataStoreFactory]
     * which on some JVM test configurations resolves to the Android artifact
     * and therefore to `FileStorage` (`java.io.File`). `FileStorage` relies
     * on `File.renameTo`, which fails on Windows when the target file already
     * exists (issue b/203087070).
     *
     * [OkioStorage] delegates file moves to Okio's `FileSystem.atomicMove`,
     * which on Windows uses `Files.move(..., ATOMIC_MOVE, REPLACE_EXISTING)`
     * and can replace an existing file.
     */
    private fun newRepository(scope: TestScope): ThemeRepository {
        dataStoreScope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO + SupervisorJob())
        val file: File = File(tempFolder.root, "test_${System.nanoTime()}.preferences_pb")
        val ds: DataStore<Preferences> = DataStoreFactory.create(
            scope = dataStoreScope,
            storage = OkioStorage(
                fileSystem = FileSystem.SYSTEM,
                serializer = PreferencesSerializer,
                producePath = { file.toOkioPath() },
            ),
        )
        return ThemeRepository(ds, scope.backgroundScope)
    }

    @After
    fun tearDown() {
        if (::dataStoreScope.isInitialized) {
            dataStoreScope.cancel()
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Initialization
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    @Test
    fun `empty DataStore yields defaults`() = runTest(UnconfinedTestDispatcher()) {
        val r = newRepository(this)
        r.awaitInitialized()

        assertEquals(ThemeSelection.DEFAULT_THEME_ID, r.getThemeIdSync())
        assertEquals(ThemeSelection.DEFAULT_NIGHT_MODE, r.getNightModeSync())
        assertTrue(r.getCustomThemesSync().isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun `currentTheme resolves to DEFAULT on empty DataStore`() = runTest(UnconfinedTestDispatcher()) {
        val r = newRepository(this)
        r.awaitInitialized()
        assertEquals(BuiltInThemes.DEFAULT.id, r.currentTheme.value.id)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Night mode
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    @Test
    fun `setNightMode persists and updates cache synchronously`() = runTest(UnconfinedTestDispatcher()) {
        val r = newRepository(this)
        r.awaitInitialized()

        r.setNightMode(AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_YES)

        assertEquals(AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_YES, r.getNightModeSync())
        assertEquals(AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_YES, r.selection.value.nightMode)
    }

    @Test
    fun `setNightMode survives repository recreation`() = runTest(UnconfinedTestDispatcher()) {
        val file = File(tempFolder.root, "persistence.preferences_pb")
        dataStoreScope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO + SupervisorJob())
        val ds = DataStoreFactory.create(
            scope = dataStoreScope,
            storage = OkioStorage(
                fileSystem = FileSystem.SYSTEM,
                serializer = PreferencesSerializer,
                producePath = { file.toOkioPath() },
            ),
        )

        val r1 = ThemeRepository(ds, backgroundScope)
        r1.awaitInitialized()
        r1.setNightMode(AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_NO)

        val r2 = ThemeRepository(ds, backgroundScope)
        r2.awaitInitialized()

        assertEquals(AppCompatDelegate.MODE_NIGHT_NO, r2.getNightModeSync())
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Theme id
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    @Test
    fun `setThemeId with built-in id persists`() = runTest(UnconfinedTestDispatcher()) {
        val r = newRepository(this)
        r.awaitInitialized()
        r.setThemeId("default")
        assertEquals("default", r.getThemeIdSync())
    }

    @Test
    fun `setThemeId with unknown id falls back to default`() = runTest(UnconfinedTestDispatcher()) {
        val r = newRepository(this)
        r.awaitInitialized()
        r.setThemeId("nonexistent_theme_xyz")
        assertEquals("default", r.getThemeIdSync())
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Custom themes
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    @Test
    fun `addOrReplaceCustomTheme stores a user theme`() = runTest(UnconfinedTestDispatcher()) {
        val r = newRepository(this)
        r.awaitInitialized()

        val custom = makeCustomTheme("custom_001", "My Theme")
        r.addOrReplaceCustomTheme(custom)

        assertEquals(1, r.getCustomThemesSync().size)
        assertEquals("custom_001", r.getCustomThemesSync()[0].id)
    }

    @Test
    fun `addOrReplaceCustomTheme with same id replaces`() = runTest(UnconfinedTestDispatcher()) {
        val r = newRepository(this)
        r.awaitInitialized()

        r.addOrReplaceCustomTheme(makeCustomTheme("custom_001", "First"))
        r.addOrReplaceCustomTheme(makeCustomTheme("custom_001", "Second"))

        assertEquals(1, r.getCustomThemesSync().size)
        assertEquals("Second", r.getCustomThemesSync()[0].displayName)
    }

    @Test
    fun `built-in theme cannot be added as custom`() = runTest(UnconfinedTestDispatcher()) {
        val r = newRepository(this)
        r.awaitInitialized()

        try {
            r.addOrReplaceCustomTheme(BuiltInThemes.DEFAULT)
            throw AssertionError("Expected IllegalArgumentException")
        } catch (e: IllegalArgumentException) {
            // expected
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun `removeCustomTheme drops it from the list`() = runTest(UnconfinedTestDispatcher()) {
        val r = newRepository(this)
        r.awaitInitialized()
        r.addOrReplaceCustomTheme(makeCustomTheme("custom_001", "X"))
        r.removeCustomTheme("custom_001")
        assertTrue(r.getCustomThemesSync().isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun `removeCustomTheme of active theme falls back to default`() = runTest(UnconfinedTestDispatcher()) {
        val r = newRepository(this)
        r.awaitInitialized()

        r.addOrReplaceCustomTheme(makeCustomTheme("custom_001", "X"))
        r.setThemeId("custom_001")
        assertEquals("custom_001", r.getThemeIdSync())

        r.removeCustomTheme("custom_001")
        assertEquals("default", r.getThemeIdSync())
    }

    @Test
    fun `custom themes survive repository recreation`() = runTest(UnconfinedTestDispatcher()) {
        val file = File(tempFolder.root, "custom_themes_persistence.preferences_pb")
        dataStoreScope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO + SupervisorJob())
        val ds = DataStoreFactory.create(
            scope = dataStoreScope,
            storage = OkioStorage(
                fileSystem = FileSystem.SYSTEM,
                serializer = PreferencesSerializer,
                producePath = { file.toOkioPath() },
            ),
        )

        val r1 = ThemeRepository(ds, backgroundScope)
        r1.awaitInitialized()
        r1.addOrReplaceCustomTheme(makeCustomTheme("custom_001", "Saved"))

        val r2 = ThemeRepository(ds, backgroundScope)
        r2.awaitInitialized()

        assertEquals(1, r2.getCustomThemesSync().size)
        assertEquals("Saved", r2.getCustomThemesSync()[0].displayName)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Resolution
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    @Test
    fun `currentTheme resolves custom theme by id`() = runTest(UnconfinedTestDispatcher()) {
        val r = newRepository(this)
        r.awaitInitialized()
        val custom = makeCustomTheme("custom_abc", "Custom")
        r.addOrReplaceCustomTheme(custom)
        r.setThemeId("custom_abc")

        assertEquals("custom_abc", r.currentTheme.value.id)
        assertEquals("Custom", r.currentTheme.value.displayName)
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Corruption
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    @Test
    fun `corrupted custom themes JSON is ignored`() = runTest(UnconfinedTestDispatcher()) {
        val file = File(tempFolder.root, "corrupt.preferences_pb")
        val ds = DataStoreFactory.create(
            scope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO + SupervisorJob()),
            storage = OkioStorage(
                fileSystem = FileSystem.SYSTEM,
                serializer = PreferencesSerializer,
                producePath = { file.toOkioPath() },
            ),
        )
        ds.edit { it[ThemePreferences.KEY_CUSTOM_THEMES] = "{not valid json" }

        val r = ThemeRepository(ds, backgroundScope)
        r.awaitInitialized()

        assertTrue(r.getCustomThemesSync().isEmpty())
        assertEquals("default", r.getThemeIdSync())
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Helpers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    private fun makeCustomTheme(id: String, displayName: String): AppThemeConfig =
        BuiltInThemes.DEFAULT.copy(
            id = id,
            displayName = displayName,
            isBuiltIn = false,
        )
}

package com.myapp.adventure.utils

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

class FontSettingsTest {

    @Test
    fun emptyRawUsesPerScopeDefaults() {
        val settings = FontSettings.resolve(RawFontSettings())

        assertEquals("EuroScript", settings.reader.fontName)
        assertEquals(19, settings.reader.sizePx)
        assertEquals("Caveat", settings.ui.fontName)
        assertEquals(23, settings.ui.sizePx)
        assertEquals("Source Sans 3", settings.editor.fontName)
        assertEquals(18, settings.editor.sizePx)
        assertEquals(FontSettings.Default, settings)
    }

    @Test
    fun legacyValuesMigrateToAllScopes() {
        val settings = FontSettings.resolve(
            RawFontSettings(
                legacyFontName = "Caveat",
                legacySizePx = 22,
            )
        )

        FontScope.entries.forEach { scope ->
            assertEquals("Caveat", settings[scope].fontName)
            assertEquals(22, settings[scope].sizePx)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun perScopeValuesOverrideLegacy() {
        val settings = FontSettings.resolve(
            RawFontSettings(
                legacyFontName = "Caveat",
                legacySizePx = 22,
                reader = StoredFontScope(fontName = "MarckScript", sizePx = 18),
                ui = StoredFontScope(fontName = "EuroScript"),
                editor = StoredFontScope(sizePx = 28),
            )
        )

        assertEquals("MarckScript", settings.reader.fontName)
        assertEquals(18, settings.reader.sizePx)
        assertEquals("EuroScript", settings.ui.fontName)
        assertEquals(22, settings.ui.sizePx)
        assertEquals("Caveat", settings.editor.fontName)
        assertEquals(28, settings.editor.sizePx)
    }

    @Test
    fun sizesAreClamped() {
        val settings = FontSettings.resolve(
            RawFontSettings(
                legacySizePx = 1000,
                reader = StoredFontScope(sizePx = 1),
                ui = StoredFontScope(sizePx = 99),
                editor = StoredFontScope(sizePx = 0),
            )
        )

        assertEquals(FontSettings.MIN_SIZE_PX, settings.reader.sizePx)
        assertEquals(FontSettings.MAX_SIZE_PX, settings.ui.sizePx)
        assertEquals(FontSettings.MIN_SIZE_PX, settings.editor.sizePx)
    }

    @Test
    fun legacyDefaultAliasIsTreatedAsUnset() {
        val settings = FontSettings.resolve(
            RawFontSettings(legacyFontName = "По умолчанию")
        )

        FontScope.entries.forEach { scope ->
            assertEquals(FontSettings.Default[scope], settings[scope])
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun migrateOldDefaultsUpgradesUntouchedValues() {
        val raw = RawFontSettings(
            legacyFontName = "Bad Script",
            legacySizePx = 16,
            reader = StoredFontScope("Bad Script", 16),
            ui = StoredFontScope("По умолчанию", 16),
            editor = StoredFontScope(sizePx = 16),
        )

        val migrated = FontSettings.migrateOldDefaults(raw)

        assertEquals(RawFontSettings(), migrated)
        assertEquals(FontSettings.Default, FontSettings.resolve(migrated))
    }

    @Test
    fun migrateOldDefaultsPreservesCustomValues() {
        val raw = RawFontSettings(
            legacyFontName = "Caveat",
            legacySizePx = 22,
            reader = StoredFontScope("MarckScript", 18),
            ui = StoredFontScope("Caveat", 23),
            editor = StoredFontScope("Source Sans 3", 18),
        )

        assertEquals(raw, FontSettings.migrateOldDefaults(raw))
    }

    @Test
    fun migrateOldDefaultsPreservesPartialCustomValues() {
        val raw = RawFontSettings(
            reader = StoredFontScope(fontName = "MarckScript"),
            ui = StoredFontScope(sizePx = 24),
            editor = StoredFontScope("Bad Script", 18),
        )

        val migrated = FontSettings.migrateOldDefaults(raw)
        val settings = FontSettings.resolve(migrated)

        assertEquals(raw, migrated)
        assertEquals("MarckScript", settings.reader.fontName)
        assertEquals(19, settings.reader.sizePx)
        assertEquals("Caveat", settings.ui.fontName)
        assertEquals(24, settings.ui.sizePx)
        assertEquals("Bad Script", settings.editor.fontName)
        assertEquals(18, settings.editor.sizePx)
    }

    @Test
    fun withUpdatesOnlyTargetScope() {
        val base = FontSettings.resolve(RawFontSettings())
        val updated = base.with(FontScope.EDITOR, fontName = "Caveat", sizePx = 24)

        assertEquals("Caveat", updated.editor.fontName)
        assertEquals(24, updated.editor.sizePx)
        assertEquals(base.reader, updated.reader)
        assertEquals(base.ui, updated.ui)
    }

    @Test
    fun withClampsSize() {
        val updated = FontSettings.Default.with(FontScope.READER, sizePx = 100)

        assertEquals(FontSettings.MAX_SIZE_PX, updated.reader.sizePx)
    }
}
